### [1] [ICALL-BENCH: Benchmarking LLM Interprocedural Reasoning in Binary Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37871)
*Shenglong Yao,Zirui Liu,Xiangchi Yuan,Wenke Lee*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 ICALL-BENCH 基准，以间接调用目标恢复为可测量探针，直接评测 LLM 与智能体在编译后二进制中的跨过程语义推理能力，并揭示该能力仍是开放难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有函数级基准难以观察跨函数关系，而整程序基准多以最终任务结果评判，任务可能仅凭局部线索、探索、工具调用、执行或检索即可解决，无法将"跨过程推理"从其他能力中剥离，因此缺少对二进制程序跨过程语义理解的直接评估手段。

Method: 构建 ICALL-BENCH：覆盖 50 个真实 C/C++ 完整程序，跨不同复杂度与多种优化配置，平均每程序 74,746 行代码、941 个函数；以间接调用目标恢复作为可验证探针任务；设置三种分析范式——纯模型推理、静态工具增强智能体、联网开放世界智能体，以分别考察内在推理、主动信息获取与外部知识的贡献；评测 5 个近期 LLM 及其对应智能体。

Result: 模型与智能体间差距显著，程序级可验证成功率在 23%–81% 之间；信息获取能力增强并不必然带来更好结果，在最难案例上提升尤为有限；不同模型表现不均衡，即使在乐观评测设定下也频现可验证失败。

Conclusion: 更充分的信息接入不能稳定改善跨过程分析，深层跨过程推理本身仍是主要瓶颈；稳健的二进制跨过程推理仍是未解决的开放挑战，ICALL-BENCH 提供了可度量、可验证的评测路径。

Abstract: Recent benchmarks show that LLMs achieve strong performance in both function-level binary understanding and end-to-end binary reverse engineering tasks, but whether LLMs can reason over interprocedural semantics in compiled binaries remains unclear. Function-level benchmarks offer limited visibility into cross-function relationships, while whole-program benchmarks typically evaluate final outcomes of tasks that may be solvable from local clues alone, making it difficult to disentangle interprocedural reasoning from exploration, tool use, execution, and retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce ICALL-BENCH, a benchmark that directly evaluates whether LLMs and agents can understand and reason over interprocedural semantics in binary programs, using indirect-call target recovery as a measurable probe. ICALL-BENCH covers 50 complete real-world C/C++ programs spanning different complexity levels and multiple optimization configurations, with an average of 74,746 lines of code and 941 functions per program. We further introduce three analysis regimes spanning model-only reasoning, static tool-augmented agents, and Internet-enabled open-world agents to examine how intrinsic reasoning, active information acquisition, and external knowledge each contribute to interprocedural binary analysis. We evaluate five recent LLMs and their corresponding agents. Our results reveal a wide separation across current models and agents, with program-level verifiable success rates ranging from 23% to 81%. They also show that greater information access does not consistently lead to better results, with particularly limited gains on the hardest cases, where deeper interprocedural reasoning remains the primary bottleneck. Uneven performance across models and frequent verifiable failures even under an optimistic evaluation indicate that robust binary interprocedural reasoning remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [2] [Cognitive Debt in the GenAI Era - Listening to Practitioners' Voices on the Loss of Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37888)
*Theocharis Tavantzis,Bianca Trinkenreich,Michaela Greiler,Júlia Condé Araújo,Marina Condé Araújo,Italo Santos,Alexander Serebrenik,Margaret-Anne Storey,Maria Teresa Baldassarre*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对76篇灰色文献的综述，系统梳理AI辅助软件开发中"认知债务"的概念、表现、成因、后果及应对实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发加速了代码产出，却可能削弱开发者对系统的理解，形成"认知债务"。该问题虽非新生，但AI加剧了它。从业者已在博客和网络讨论中先于学术研究识别并记录这一现象，因此需要整合这些灰色文献以理解其关切，为后续研究与实践提供基础。

Method: 灰色文献综述，分析76个来源（博客文章、在线讨论等），围绕认知债务的概念界定与表现形式、促成因素、后果，以及预防、检测与缓解的实践展开归纳分析。

Result: 认知债务会在"代码可运行、测试通过"的表象下悄然累积，尤其在开发者不加理解地接受AI生成方案时。从业者报告的后果包括维护与调试更困难、团队知识碎片化、生产力下降；提出的实践包括记录设计理由、限定评审规模的变更、设置理解门槛、建立知识分享仪式，并借助可靠性指标等信号加以检测。

Conclusion: 研究为软件团队提供了AI辅助开发中新兴实践的结构化视图，强调在加快代码生产的同时必须保留人的理解能力。

Abstract: Fast-paced AI-assisted software development risks reducing developers' understanding of the systems they build. This growing gap between what the system does and what developers understand about it, described as ``cognitive debt'', is not new, but AI has exacerbated it. This has led to a recent surge in blog posts and online discussions, in which practitioners recognize and write about cognitive debt, and share their experiences well before academic studies can capture them. To understand their concerns and inform future research and practice, we conduct a grey literature review of 76 sources, focusing on how cognitive debt is conceptualized and manifests, its contributing factors, its consequences, and the practices to prevent, detect, and mitigate it. We find that cognitive debt can accumulate unnoticed behind working code and passing tests, particularly when developers accept AI-generated solutions without building understanding. Practitioners report consequences such as harder maintenance and debugging, fragmented knowledge in the team, and reduced productivity. They propose practices such as documenting design rationale, review-sized changes, comprehension gates, and knowledge-sharing rituals, along with signals like reliability metrics to detect it. Our findings give software teams a structured view of emerging practical approaches in AI-assisted development and stress the need to preserve human understanding alongside faster code production.

</details>


### [3] [Reusable LLM-Based Plans with Probabilistic Guarantees for Self-Adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38039)
*Asher Tempest Arya,Rajan Maghera,Nicholas Wu Jiang,Federico Mora,Aren A. Babikian,Marsha Chechik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个“验证器引导”的框架，将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检测相结合，以支持环境族的控制器复用，并为每个实例提供概率需求保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应系统需应对环境的多种变体，构成一族实例，其不确定性由概率模型刻画，且每个实例都须满足概率需求。族内规模与结构的变化使核心自适应决策（保留、复用还是新建控制器）变得困难，因为控制器通常针对特定实例合成。现有LLM写控制器的方法主要面向确定性领域，其输出的概率模型检测仅限于初步的单实例研究。

Method: 提出验证器引导的控制器复用框架，明确支持环境族；将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检测新颖结合，为每个实例提供概率需求保证。在三个基准上使用三种LLM评估，考察相对基线实现的有效性与成本、自适应决策分布及框架各组件的贡献。

Result: 在网格世界上，LLM编写的规则列表在约90%的留出实例上通过验证，基线至多77%；验证已存储规则列表比逐实例合成快15–103倍。复用以远低于生成或逐实例合成的成本服务大多数回合，且模型检测反馈相比独立重启提高了验证覆盖率。

Conclusion: 将LLM控制器编写与概率模型检测结合的验证器引导框架，可在环境族场景下实现高覆盖率、低成本的控制器复用，并为每个实例提供概率需求保证。

Abstract: Self-adaptive systems are designed to accommodate variants of their environment, which form a family of instances whose uncertainty is captured by probabilistic models, and must meet probabilistic requirements on each instance. Within such a family, changes in size and structure complicate the fundamental adaptation decision: whether to retain, reuse, or construct a new controller, since controllers are often synthesized for and specific to an instance. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been used to write reusable controllers, but existing approaches largely target deterministic domains, and probabilistic model checking of their output remains limited to preliminary single-instance studies. In this paper, we propose a verifier-guided framework for controller reuse with explicit support for families of environments. The framework introduces a novel combination of LLM-written controllers with probabilistic model checking to provide per-instance guarantees for probabilistic requirements. We evaluate our approach using three LLMs on three benchmarks, assessing its effectiveness and cost with respect to baseline implementations, the distribution of adaptation decisions, and the impact of individual framework components. On grid worlds, LLM-written rule lists are verified on about 90% of held-out instances, against at most 77% for the baselines, and verifying a stored rule list is 15 to 103 times faster than per-instance synthesis. Reuse serves most episodes at a small fraction of the cost of generation or per-instance synthesis, and model-checking feedback increases verified coverage over independent restarts.

</details>


### [4] [Understanding Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption: Practices, Challenges, and Evolution in Open-Source Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38054)
*Souhardya Saha Dip,Moshood A. Fakorede,Krishna Upadhyay,Umar Farooq*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过挖掘179个开源仓库的114,361次提交与5,713个issue，实证刻画PQC（后量子密码）支持的实现与维护现状：90%提交属维护性工作，issue归为11类技术难题，迁移需重视持续维护与构建可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PQC标准已确立量子安全算法，但软件项目实际如何实现与维护PQC支持的实证证据有限，缺乏对开发者真实工作形态、技术障碍及标准化里程碑影响的量化认识。

Method: 挖掘179个开源仓库的114,361次提交和5,713个issue；采用人工标注与经验证的LLM分类识别提交中的PQC算法、判定采纳状态与部署模式，并从issue中归纳技术挑战；结合时间序列分析及以NIST标准化里程碑为参照的首次实现分析。

Result: 90%的提交涉及既有PQC支持的维护；构建11类技术挑战分类法，构建/打包/依赖失败与功能缺陷约占已分类issue的一半；2024年标准定稿后，标准算法名称出现在超80%的PQC开发变更中，但Kyber等旧名仍持续出现；开发活动整体上升；里程碑分析未发现首次实现显著增加。

Conclusion: 迁移计划应预估持续维护成本，优先保障构建可靠性与集成测试，并同时追踪标准名称与前身算法名称；作者公开了数据集、分类法、标注与分析流水线。

Abstract: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards establish algorithms for quantum-safe systems, but empirical evidence about how software projects implement and maintain PQC support remains limited. We investigate this implementation and maintenance work by mining 114,361 commits and 5,713 issues across 179 open-source repositories. We use human annotation and validated LLM classification to identify PQC algorithms in commits, classify their adoption status and deployment mode, and identify technical challenges in issue discussions. The commit classification for PQC algorithms reveals that 90% of commits concern maintenance of existing support. From the issue discussions, we construct an 11-category taxonomy of recurring technical challenges. Build, packaging, and dependency failures, along with functional defects, account for approximately half of categorized issues. To examine how PQC support evolves, we use time-series analysis and first implementations of individual algorithms within repositories around NIST standardization milestones. After the 2024 finalization, standardized algorithm names appeared in more than 80% of the PQC development changes analyzed, although earlier names such as Kyber continued to appear. Development activity increased over the observation period. Our milestone analysis, however, did not find a significant increase in first implementations. Migration plans should therefore account for sustained maintenance, prioritize build reliability and integration testing, and track both standardized and predecessor algorithm names. We make the dataset, taxonomy, annotations, and analysis pipeline publicly available.

</details>


### [5] [Template-Free Dynamic Invariant Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38130)
*Erfan Arvan,Michael D. Ernst,Martin Kellogg*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Oca 用 LLM 替代模板库生成动态不变式，并通过包装候选、线程级单候选求值、停滞检测重试与增量调试隔离副作用来保证安全执行；在真实 Java 项目上不变式更具表达力、假阳性更低（18% vs 76%）、缺陷发现更多（9/25 vs 4/25），且开销显著更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统动态不变式检测器（如 Daikon）依赖固定模板库生成候选不变式，表达力受限，无法刻画项目特有方法调用等复杂性质。LLM 有望提供超越模板的表达能力并降低推断成本，但其生成的候选可执行任意代码，会带来副作用与死循环等运行风险，因此需要兼顾表达力与安全性的机制。

Method: 核心思路是用 LLM（配合恰当的提示与上下文选择）生成不变式候选，与模板候选并用或替代之。安全性方面提出三项 instrumentation 策略：(1) 对每个候选进行包装，且每个线程一次只求值一个不变式，防止嵌套求值相互触发导致无限递归；(2) 对每次运行做停滞监控，在递增的时间预算下重试，以从非嵌套挂起中恢复；(3) 由于无法事先证明候选无副作用，在失败测试涉及的已求值不变式集合上做 delta debugging，定位并禁用副作用候选而不丢弃其余运行结果。实现为工具 Oca，并与基于模板的 Daikon 在真实开源 Java 项目上对比。

Result: Oca 的保留不变式中平均 28% 调用了项目特有方法，为 Daikon 模板无法表达；人工检查假阳性率 18%，Daikon 为 76%；作为 property-based testing 的性质，Oca 暴露出 25 个真实缺陷中的 9 个，Daikon 为 4 个；成本上 Oca 使用 566 分钟与 27 GB 磁盘，Daikon 为 2,817 分钟与 827 GB。

Conclusion: LLM 生成不变式在表达力、有效性、实用性上均优于模板式检测器，同时大幅降低时间与存储开销；其固有风险可通过包装隔离、单线程单候选求值、停滞重试与增量调试试隔离等机制有效缓解，使 LLM 驱动的动态不变式检测成为可行且经济的方案。

Abstract: A dynamic invariant detector proposes invariants, such as method pre- and postconditions, and rules out those that do not hold at run time. Traditional detectors propose invariants from a fixed library of templates, which limits their expressiveness. A large language model (LLM) can propose invariants instead of, or in addition to, template-derived ones. With the right prompt and context choices, we found that this idea can both improve the invariants' expressiveness and reduce the cost of inferring the invariants.
  Greater expressiveness brings complications: an LLM-proposed invariant can execute arbitrary code during invariant evaluation, causing side effects or infinite loops. Our novel instrumentation strategies mitigate these problems. We wrap each candidate and evaluate only one invariant per thread at a time, so nested invariant evaluations cannot trigger one another indefinitely. To recover from non-nested hangs, we monitor each run for stalls and retry it under a growing time budget. Because we cannot prove a candidate side-effect-free in advance, we use delta debugging over the invariants evaluated during a failing test to isolate and disable a side-effecting candidate without discarding the rest of the run.
  We compared our implementation, Oca, to the popular template-based Daikon invariant detector on real open-source Java projects. Oca produces more expressive invariants: on average, 28% of its held invariants call a project-specific method, which Daikon's templates cannot express. Its invariants are more often valid, with a false-positive rate of 18% in a manual inspection, vs. 76% for Daikon, and more useful: as properties for property-based testing, they exposed 9 of 25 real bugs, compared with 4 for Daikon. Oca also costs less, using 566 minutes and 27 GB of disk, compared with 2,817 minutes and 827 GB for Daikon.

</details>


### [6] [Mentorship, Interrupted: How GenAI Disrupts the GSoC Pipeline and Why Mentors Matter More](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38167)
*Ruizhe Xing,Zixuan Feng,Mary Radomile,Stephanie Taylor,Sophia Vargas,Anita Sarma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究生成式AI如何改变GSoC开源导师制：AI降低了产出成本，却削弱了作品作为新人能力证据的有效性，导师需额外核查并消耗本就紧张的时间与善意，据此提出AIM决策框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GenAI使开源贡献更易生成、也更难反映贡献者本人。在开源导师制中，导师依赖新人作品判断其理解程度，新人依赖导师反馈学习，因此需要理解GenAI如何改变这一评估与反馈机制，并帮助组织找到可持续的应对方式。

Method: 对Google Summer of Code（GSoC）受限导师邮件列表中2022年11月至2026年3月的全部帖子进行筛查，并访谈15位导师与组织管理员。

Result: GenAI在入门引导、协作协调与初审中有所帮助；但申请提案、入门贡献和新人的回答作为"新人能做什么"的证据明显变弱。导师通过额外核查弥补差距，而核查消耗了项目自我延续所需的时间与善意，已有一个组织退出GSoC。各组织反应从禁止到接受不一，所划边界决定了由谁承担核查工作。

Conclusion: 提出AIM决策框架，将可接受的GenAI使用范围、导师流程中的集成方式与导师承载能力三者关联，帮助组织选择可持续的应对策略。

Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) makes open source software (OSS) contributions cheaper to produce, and it makes them say less about the people who produced them. In OSS mentoring, that matters: mentors judge what newcomers understand from their work, and newcomers learn from mentors' feedback. We studied how GenAI is changing mentoring in Google Summer of Code (GSoC), a program in which today's mentees can become tomorrow's mentors. We screened every thread on GSoC's restricted mentors' mailing list from November 2022 through March 2026 and interviewed 15 mentors and organization administrators. GenAI helped with onboarding, coordination, and first-pass review, but proposals, entry contributions, and mentees' answers became weaker evidence of what newcomers could do. Mentors made up the difference by checking, and that checking drew on the same time and goodwill the program needs to renew itself; one organization had withdrawn from GSoC. Responses ranged from banning GenAI to accepting it, and the boundary an organization drew determined who did the checking. We propose AIM, a decision framework that links acceptable GenAI use, integration into the mentoring pipeline, and mentoring capacity, to help organizations choose responses they can sustain.

</details>


### [7] [Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38214)
*Aditya Golatkar,Alessandro Achille,Renos Zabounidis,Vlad Sobal,Yangruibo Ding,Baishakhi Ray,Jonathan Buck,Guy Van den Broeck,Maryam Fazel,Pietro Perona,Wei Xia,Stefano Soatto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"骨架编程"(Skeleton Coding)：开发者除行为规格(测试/输入输出示例)外，同时以高层代码式格式指定程序结构(数据类型、模块、函数分解)，从而指数级减少所需测试数量并显著降低测试误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端行为规格(测试、I/O示例)能否充分确定开发者意图的程序，取决于实现结构，而结构由编码智能体自行决定。同一组测试对某结构充分，对另一结构可能严重欠定，需要不同边界用例甚至指数级更多示例；开发者若要确保规格完备，只能从数千行生成代码中逆向推断结构。

Method: 提出Skeleton Coding：开发者在提供行为规格的同时，以高层、类代码格式联合指定结构(数据类型、模块、函数分解)。理论上将AI辅助编码建模为控制问题，分析骨架对测试数量的压缩作用；实证上在4个模型、3个基准上比较骨架规格与最佳端到端行为规格，并在智能体可查询完整参考实现的条件下测试骨架的增量效果。

Result: 最佳骨架规格相对最佳端到端行为规格将平均测试误差降低48.4%；即使可查询完整参考实现，加入骨架仍使平均测试误差相对降低最多27.0%；骨架使大/小模型平均差距缩小约52.4%，实现成本降低15–26倍，代码侵蚀平均减少24.7%。

Conclusion: 规格完备性不能先验确定，因为其依赖于由智能体选择的结构；让开发者参与结构指定可指数级减少测试负担，并在误差、模型差距、成本与代码维护性上带来一致收益，说明结构规格应成为编码智能体接口的一等组成部分。

Abstract: Coding agents are typically provided end-to-end behavioral specifications that the code they produce should satisfy, such as tests and input--output examples. How many such specifications must a developer provide, and which ones, for the agent to produce the developer's intended program? We argue that this cannot be determined a priori, for it depends on the structure of the implementation, which is left to the agent to decide. An agent first commits to a structure---a decomposition into data types, modules, and functions---which fixes a class of candidate programs; behavioral specifications then select a program within that class. A set of tests that suffices for one structure may leave another badly underdetermined, requiring different edge cases or exponentially more examples. Since the structure is chosen by the agent, developers cannot ensure their specification is complete without reverse-engineering it from thousands of lines of generated code. To resolve this, we introduce Skeleton Coding, in which developers jointly specify the structure---in high-level, code-like format---alongside behavioral specifications. Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program. Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications. Even when the agent can query a complete reference implementation, adding a skeleton reduces mean test error relatively by up to 27.0%. Skeletons also narrow the average gap between small and large models by about 52.4% while lowering implementation cost by 15--26x, and reduce code erosion by 24.7% on average.

</details>


### [8] [Precedent or Intent? What Coding Agents Follow When Evolving Existing Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38244)
*Haichao Zhu,Geyang Xu,Zhaorui Yang,Jiyuan Wang,Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究编码智能体在"遵循既有代码 vs 遵循新指令"冲突下的选择机制：智能体默认偏好高度一致，且压倒性遵循仓库先例；但先例影响力取决于文件位置与类型，显式书面优先级规则能显著提升正确遵循新意图的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码只体现过去的实现决策而不解释其理由。当智能体实现新功能或修改旧功能时，过往决策可能与新任务指令冲突。核心问题是：多种实现同样满足功能需求时，智能体如何在既有代码与新指令之间抉择。现有研究缺乏对"默认偏好、仓库先例、显式指令"三类竞争性指导来源的隔离与量化。

Method: 采用双向受控实验：在专门构建的仓库中隔离三类指导来源（智能体默认偏好、仓库先例、显式任务指令），随后在真实开源仓库中验证。共进行5,625次试验，覆盖4个编码智能体、6组实现配对；验证集为跨3种编程语言的4个开源仓库。另对比"书面优先级规则"与"纯代码示例"在意图冲突场景下的效果，并通过移动文件位置、改变文件数量与类型做消融。

Result: (1) 各智能体默认实现偏好高度一致；(2) 当仓库先例与默认偏好冲突时，智能体压倒性遵循先例（359/360）；(3) 先例影响力不等价——3个本地支撑文件带来96%采纳率，而同级资源文件仅4%；在示例数量固定时，仅改变文件位置即可使采纳率从0%跃升至100%；(4) 新意图与既有代码冲突时，书面优先级规则联合成功率显著高于纯代码示例（59/60 vs 38/60）；(5) 在开源仓库中，由harness加载的规则将联合成功率从0/120提升至117/120。

Conclusion: 智能体的行为由默认偏好、先例的具体呈现方式与显式规则共同决定，其中先例的位置/类型与书面优先级规则具有决定性影响。据此提出"设计决策可追溯性"（design-decision traceability）：不仅保留实现选择，还应保留其理由与未来变更应遵循的优先级。

Abstract: Existing code reveals past implementation decisions but rarely explains the reasoning behind them. When coding agents implement new features or modify existing functionality, past decisions may conflict with new task instructions. This raises a fundamental question for agentic software evolution: when multiple implementations satisfy the same functional requirements, how do coding agents decide whether to follow existing code or new task instructions? We investigate this question through bidirectional, controlled experiments in purpose-built repositories, followed by validation in real-world open-source repositories. Our approach isolates three competing sources of guidance: (1) agents' default preferences, (2) repository precedents, and (3) explicit task instructions. We conduct 5,625 trials across four coding agents and six implementation pairs, with validation in four open-source repositories spanning three programming languages. We find that agents share the same default implementation choices, yet overwhelmingly follow repository precedent when it conflicts with those defaults (359/360 trials). Crucially, not all precedents carry equal influence: three supporting local files yield 96% adoption, compared with only 4% for sibling-resource files, and changing file placement alone can shift adoption from 0% to 100% at a fixed example count. When new task intent conflicts with existing code, written priority rules achieve substantially higher success than code examples alone (59/60 versus 38/60 joint successes for two agents on two implementation pairs). The effectiveness of explicit rules also extends to open-source repositories, where a harness-loaded rule raises joint success from 0/120 to 117/120. These findings motivate design-decision traceability that preserves not only implementation choices but also the rationale and priorities that should guide future changes.

</details>


### [9] [Detecting Incorrect LLM Explanations for Automated Program Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38311)
*Lam Nguyen Tung,Chenxi Gu,Xiaoning Du,Haoye Tian,Aldeida Aleti,Neelofar Neelofar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出MetaReJ，首个利用蜕变测试检测LLM生成的自动程序修复（APR）解释是否错误的方法，无需外部验证器，通过对程序变体进行递归质询并检测矛盾来实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的APR解释可帮助开发者理解修复理由并评估补丁质量，但错误解释会误导开发者对修复可靠性的判断，因此检测错误解释很重要。人工检查海量生成修复不现实，需要自动化检测。现有方法主要针对通用问答LLM的错误答案，依赖采样多个响应检测矛盾，应用于APR时存在两点局限：(1) 可能依赖不可用或缺乏APR专门推理的外部验证器；(2) 改写或对同一输入重复提示等采样策略常产生表面化、冗余的响应，重复原始错误而非暴露错误。

Method: MetaReJ受辩论与口头答辩启发，采用论辩式策略质询解释，无需外部验证器。它定义新颖的蜕变关系（MRs），在等价与非等价修复场景下递归质询LLM并检测矛盾。为获得多样样本，将缺陷程序变换为保留或改变底层缺陷的变体，再询问LLM如何修复各变体；将响应间的矛盾编码为MR违反，以判定原解释错误。

Result: 在由多个基于LLM的APR系统生成的1,756条人工标注解释数据集上评估，MetaReJ的MCC最高达0.43，较先前方法在MCC上最高提升333.3%。

Conclusion: MetaReJ是首个用蜕变测试检测错误APR解释的方法，通过程序变体与递归质询规避外部验证器依赖和冗余采样问题，实验表明其在错误解释检测上显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: LLM-generated explanations help developers understand automated program repair (APR) rationale and assess patch quality. Incorrect explanations can mislead developers about a repair's reliability, making their detection important. However, manually inspecting the growing volume of generated repairs is impractical, motivating automated detection.
  Existing methods mainly target incorrect answers from general question-answering LLMs, often by sampling multiple responses and detecting contradictions. Applied to APR, they face two limitations: (1) they may depend on external verifiers that are unavailable or lack APR-specific reasoning; and (2) sampling strategies such as paraphrasing or re-prompting the same input often yield superficial, redundant responses that repeat the original error rather than expose it.
  We propose MetaReJ, the first method designed to detect incorrect APR explanations using metamorphic testing. Inspired by debate and viva examinations, MetaReJ challenges explanations through an argumentative strategy without requiring external verifiers. It applies novel metamorphic relations (MRs) to recursively question the LLM under equivalent and non-equivalent repair scenarios and detect contradictions. To obtain diverse samples, MetaReJ transforms the buggy program into variants that preserve or alter the underlying bug, then asks the LLM how to repair each variant. Contradictions among responses are encoded as MR violations, which indicate that the original explanation is incorrect. We evaluate MetaReJ on a manually labelled dataset of 1,756 explanations from multiple LLM-based APR systems. MetaReJ achieves an MCC of up to 0.43, outperforming prior methods by up to 333.3% in MCC.

</details>


### [10] [DIFUZZI: A Differential Fuzzing Tool for Code Functional Similarity Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38337)
*Simantika Bhattacharjee Dristi,Matthew B. Dwyer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DIFUZZI 通过引入基于LLM的差分测试输入生成器合成步骤（迭代验证与修复），自动化了差分模糊测试中构建输入生成器的人工环节，从而推动差分模糊测试在软件行为相似性评估中的广泛应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化、重构等软件工程任务需要保持组件行为，因此需评估功能相似性。形式化等价性证明不可扩展且无法量化相似程度；机器学习近似方法在存在细微语义差异时表现不佳；差分模糊测试虽可扩展，但需要大量人工构建适配目标程序对的输入生成器。

Method: 提出 DIFUZZI，在差分模糊测试流程中嵌入基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成器合成步骤，并对合成结果进行迭代验证与修复。

Result: 实现了输入生成器构建的自动化，降低了差分模糊测试的使用门槛，为其更广泛应用铺平道路；工具已开源并提供演示视频。

Conclusion: LLM 驱动的生成器合成可有效替代差分模糊测试中的人工输入生成器编写工作，DIFUZZI 使差分模糊测试更易部署于功能相似性评估任务。

Abstract: A range of software engineering tasks, such as optimization and refactoring, seek to preserve the behavior of software components and require methods to assess functional similarity. Research has explored formal approaches to prove functional equivalence and used machine learning methods to approximate it, but the former does not scale and does not quantify the extent of similarity and the latter struggles when subtle semantic differences are present. Differential fuzzing offers a scalable approach for differencing programs semantically, but applying it often requires substantial manual effort to construct input generators that are well-suited to a target pair of programs. To address this challenge, we introduce DIFUZZI, which incorporates an LLM-based generator synthesis step that is iteratively validated and repaired. By automating this step, DIFUZZI paves the way for broader applicability of differential fuzzing. We release DIFUZZI at https://github.com/Dristi123/difuzzi_tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/FlHNOHuo9WE

</details>


### [11] [Security Impact of Coding Agent's Memory Files](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38521)
*Thiago Santos de Moura,Selma Güler,Yannic Noller*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 将项目记忆文件（如CLAUDE.md）视为不安全的攻击面：12类CWE、24个恶意记忆文件、36个SecRepoBench任务实验表明，恶意记忆文件对安全完成率影响仅-8~+6个百分点且无一致规律；不同智能体向开发者披露记忆文件影响的程度差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体在每次会话开始时自动加载项目记忆文件并将其视为可信的项目指导，因此任何能修改该文件的人（如通过pull request）都能在不接触开发者提示词的情况下操纵智能体。作者据此把记忆文件作为不安全代码生成的攻击面，关注两个问题：(1) 恶意记忆文件是否使智能体生成"通过测试但存在漏洞"的代码；(2) 智能体是否向开发者披露该文件影响了其代码。

Method: 针对12个CWE类别各构造两个恶意记忆文件（"qualified"变体将移除防御性检查包装为工程最佳实践；"forceful"变体直接要求移除），在36个SecRepoBench任务上，对Claude Code（Sonnet 5.5）与OpenCode（Qwen 3.8 27B、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）分别在有无这些文件条件下进行对照运行，统计安全完成率变化并分析最终消息与推理轨迹中的披露行为。

Result: 恶意文件使安全完成率变化为-8至+6个百分点，跨智能体与变体均无一致模式；披露行为差异明显：Claude Code在约三分之二的最终消息中提及该文件，而OpenCode几乎只在推理轨迹中提及，不进入开发者阅读的最终消息；将文件标记为攻击并不能可靠地保护代码，此类智能体仍生成脆弱代码。

Conclusion: 记忆文件作为攻击面对安全性的影响在当前实验规模下不显著且不稳定，但披露缺失与防御失效构成实质风险；需开展更大规模研究以量化跨智能体风险并设计防御措施。

Abstract: Coding agents automatically load project memory files such as CLAUDE.md at the start of every session and treat them as trusted project guidance. Anyone who can change such a file, for example through a pull request, can therefore steer the agent without ever touching the developer's prompt. We study memory files as an attack surface for insecure code generation and ask (1) whether a malicious memory file makes agents produce code that passes its tests but is vulnerable, and (2) whether agents disclose to the developer that the file shaped their code. For each of 12 CWE classes, we crafted two malicious memory files, a qualified variant that presents removing defensive checks as engineering best practice and a forceful variant that demands it. We ran Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) and OpenCode (Qwen 3.8 27B, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) on 36 SecRepoBench tasks with and without these files. The malicious files changed the rate of secure completions by -8 to +6 percentage points, with no consistent pattern across agents or variants. Agents differ sharply in what they tell the developer about the file. Claude Code names it in about two thirds of its final messages, whereas OpenCode mentions it almost exclusively in its reasoning trace, not in the final message the developer reads. Flagging the file as an attack does not reliably protect the code, as such agents still generated vulnerable code. We outline the larger studies needed to quantify this risk across agents and to design defenses.

</details>


### [12] [Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38610)
*Yijun Liao,Fanwei Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文检验“修复动作的选择者”与“实际执行者”是否一致：在固定失败轨迹与候选单步修复的前提下，用部署策略自身的独立 rollout 作为真值标签，量化贪心重放、更强模型、环境 oracle 与日志评判器等评估器所选修复带来的部署价值损失。结果显示，除直接用执行者自身 rollout 外，各类评估器均显著劣于“用作执行者的模型自己来评分”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 失败修复方法在做“替换哪一步、替换成什么”的候选选择时，常用贪心重放、更强模型评分、环境 oracle 或读取失败日志的评判器来打分。但修复最终是由部署中的那个 agent 去执行的，评估器与执行者不一致可能导致所选修复对真实执行者并非最优。作者因此要回答：这些评估器能否选出真正帮助执行者的修复。

Method: 控制变量式实证：固定失败轨迹与候选单步修复集合，用部署策略自身的独立 rollout 为每个候选打标签（部署价值），再比较各评估器选中候选相对“按部署 agent 自身 rollout 选择”的期望净收益损失。在 ALFWorld（期望净成功增益）与 WebShop（净奖励）上做预设检验，并设置等 rollout 预算对比（Qwen2.5-7B 执行 vs Qwen2.5-14B 评分）、跨家族同规模模型对比，以及分歧样本上的新一轮 rollout 复核；另考察评分执行者如何改变修复位置标签与方法排名。

Result: 在未筛选修复价值的失败上，贪心重放相对部署 agent 自身 rollout 选择，ALFWorld 期望净成功增益损失 0.08–0.13，WebShop 净奖励损失 0.06–0.13。等 rollout 预算下，用 Qwen2.5-14B 为 Qwen2.5-7B 选修复，损失 ALFWorld 0.25、WebShop 0.07；每候选 20 次 14B rollout 的价值不超过 2 次 7B agent 自身 rollout；新 rollout 确认两模型在分歧案例上偏好相反的修复。跨家族同规模模型间，损失在两个方向上均出现于两个环境（0.07–0.17）。评分执行者还会改变修复位置标签与方法排名。

Conclusion: 修复必须以“将要执行它的那个执行者”来验证，强模型或代理评分不能替代；修复方法的标签（如位置标注、方法排名）应显式注明其评分执行者，否则结论不可迁移。

Abstract: When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.

</details>


### [13] [When LLM Architectures Meet Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection: a Replication Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38621)
*Gerardo Iuliano,Gabriele De Vito,Dario Di Nucci*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对Chen等人关于LLM智能合约漏洞检测的实证研究进行扩展复现：在GPT-4上完成精确复现，并在MoE、类RNN架构模型及初步的SSM模型上开展差异化复现。结果显示GPT-4的高召回低精确模式可被复现，但该模式不能随架构家族均匀迁移；架构家族不足以预测检测表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能合约漏洞检测证据几乎全部来自GPT系列的稠密Transformer架构，且多基于已计划弃用的模型快照，因此无法判断所报告的行为是LLM的普遍性质，还是特定架构设计的产物。

Method: 采用扩展复现设计：先在GPT-4上按原始协议做精确复现作为基线；再做差异化复现，将同一协议应用于基于混合专家（MoE）与类RNN设计的代表性模型，并对状态空间模型（SSM）进行初步评估尝试；比较各模型的检测表现。

Result: 精确复现证实了Chen等人的发现，包括GPT-4上的高召回、低精确检测模式。差异化复现表明该模式并非均匀迁移。GPT-4与Gemma-3虽参数量相差约两个数量级，却呈现相同的定性稠密Transformer特征；而来自不同谱系的两个MoE模型则表现出定性上分化的行为。

Conclusion: 架构家族本身不足以预测LLM在智能合约漏洞检测中的检测表现，需要在更多架构上重新验证已有结论，不能将基于GPT稠密Transformer的证据直接外推。

Abstract: Smart contracts are immutable programs deployed on blockchain platforms, where vulnerabilities can translate directly into financial loss. Among the techniques proposed for their detection, recent work has relied increasingly on Large Language Models (LLMs) guided by carefully crafted prompts. However, the evidence accumulated so far rests almost entirely on the dense Transformer architecture behind the GPT line and on model snapshots already scheduled for deprecation, leaving open the question of whether the reported behaviors reflect a general property of LLMs or an artifact of that specific design.
  This paper presents an extended replication of the empirical study by Chen et al. on LLM-based smart contract vulnerability detection. We replicate the original protocol on GPT-4 as a baseline, followed by a differentiated replication, executing the protocol on representative models based on Mixture-of-Experts and RNN-like designs, together with an attempted preliminary evaluation of State Space Models. The exact replication confirms the findings of Chen et al., including the high-recall, low-precision detection pattern they report on GPT-4. Nevertheless, the differentiated replication shows that this pattern does not transfer uniformly across the evaluated models. Those from the same architectural family may also exhibit different behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the resulting detection profile. We observe the same qualitative dense-Transformer profile in both GPT-4 and Gemma-3, despite a gap of roughly two orders of magnitude in parameter counts, whereas two Mixture-of-Experts models from different lineages exhibit qualitatively divergent behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the detection profile.

</details>


### [14] [The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38628)
*Stefano Carlo Lambertenghi,Oliver Weissl,Johannes Betz,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对235项研究自动驾驶（ADS）仿真-现实差距（reality gap）的一手文献进行系统性映射，区分"模拟/真实执行"与"构建依据/评估证据"，指出当前证据无法建立差距与测试结论间的因果关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真对ADS测试至关重要，但仿真与现实的不一致会削弱测试结论的可信度；文献中究竟针对哪些不一致、以何种证据支撑"仿真对应现实"的主张尚不清晰。

Method: 从4,195篇文献中筛选235篇测量或缓解ADS测试现实差距的一手研究，系统映射其目标、对象、方法、实验设置与评估证据；按6类ADS测试组件区分模拟执行与真实执行，并分别对每种方法及其评估参照进行标注，从而区分"用于构建方法的真实信息"与"用于评估其主张的证据"。

Result: 76%的研究聚焦差距缓解，主要针对场景与交通参与者真实性和感知；94%报告了验证或测量流程；仅61项研究报告了覆盖传感器/感知对应、ADS行为、车辆动力学或安全结果等多族指标，且该覆盖不足以建立差距与测试判定之间的因果联系。

Conclusion: 真实世界内容与物理执行须结合具体被评估的主张来解读；研究呼吁采用主张特定（claim-specific）的评估与组件级报告，以厘清哪些差距影响测试结论、以及何时仿真证据可支撑关于真实ADS行为的结论。

Abstract: Simulation is essential for testing automated driving systems (ADS), but discrepancies between simulation and reality can undermine testing conclusions. It remains unclear which discrepancies the literature addresses and what evidence supports correspondence claims. We present a systematic mapping of 235 primary studies that measure or mitigate the reality gap in ADS testing, selected from 4,195 publications. We characterise objectives, targets, approaches, experimental setups, and evaluation evidence. Our classification distinguishes simulated and real-world execution across six ADS test components, separately for each approach and its evaluation reference. This distinguishes real-world information used to construct an approach from evidence used to evaluate its claims. Of the included studies, 76% address mitigation, primarily targeting scenario and actor realism and perception, while 94% report validation or measurement procedures. Only 61 studies report metrics from multiple families covering sensor/perception correspondence, ADS behaviour, vehicle dynamics, or safety outcomes; this coverage does not establish causal links between discrepancies and test verdicts. The synthesis highlights that real-world content and physical execution must be interpreted against the claim evaluated. The findings motivate claim-specific evaluation and component-level reporting to establish which discrepancies affect testing conclusions and when simulation evidence supports conclusions about real-world ADS behaviour.

</details>


### [15] [Write Once, Instrument Anywhere: Portable, Sandboxed Tooling with WebAssembly Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38682)
*Elizabeth Gilbert,Chris Fallin,Heather Miller,Ben L. Titzer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Splicer 是一个基于 WebAssembly 组件的插桩框架，为已部署软件提供语义丰富的应用级类型、可插拔工具、跨语言与硬件可移植性，并将每个工具限制在显式授权的沙箱中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监控与调试已部署软件对可扩展性、性能和鲁棒性至关重要，而横切关注点广泛存在，工程师却只能用碎片化工具箱应对。高层框架锁定特定语言/运行时/硬件，可移植性迫使采用低层插桩（如 eBPF）。现有方案存在四类问题：应用级类型与低层字节/数据包之间的取舍、领域专用工具不可组合、跨框架特性碎片化、工具常以不受限权限访问程序及环境。

Method: 提出 Splicer——一个 WebAssembly 组件插桩（interposition）框架，具备四点特性：1) 提供语义丰富的应用级类型；2) 支持具有强大能力的可插拔工具；3) 通过跨语言、跨硬件移植降低生态碎片化；4) 将每个工具限制在具有显式授予权限的沙箱中。

Result: 在一组基准测试上评估 Splicer，展示了用多种源语言编写的非平凡工具的可插拔性及其性能表现。

Conclusion: Splicer 通过 WebAssembly 组件插桩，在保持应用级语义与可移植性的同时实现可组合、可插拔且最小权限的工具生态，缓解了现有插桩方案的类型取舍、碎片化与权限过大的问题。

Abstract: Monitoring and debugging deployed software is crucial for scalability, performance, and robustness. Cross-cutting concerns are pervasive across software ecosystems, yet engineers must address them with a fragmented toolbox. While high-level frameworks exist to offer application-level types and semantics, they often lock a solution into specific languages, runtimes, or hardware architectures. Portability often forces engineers to choose lower-level instrumentation mechanisms. For example, in-language frameworks can trace a request across processes, but multi-language contexts require instrumentation at the boundary, for example using eBPF. While these frameworks provide powerful capabilities, they often result in 1) a tradeoff between application-level types or low-level bytes and packets, 2) non-composable domain-specific tools, 3) feature fragmentation across frameworks, and 4) tools that often run with unrestricted access to the program and its environment.
  We address these problems with Splicer, a WebAssembly component interposition framework that 1) provides semantically rich application-level types, 2) enables pluggable tooling with powerful capabilities, 3) reduces ecosystem fragmentation through porting across languages and hardware, and 4) confines each tool to a sandbox with explicitly granted permissions. We evaluate Splicer on a suite of benchmarks demonstrating the pluggability of non-trivial tooling written in multiple source languages and their performance.

</details>


### [16] [When Relevant Code Is Wrong: Runtime-Aware Context for AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38800)
*Wesley K. G. Assunção,Ramesh Periyathambi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"运行上下文有效性"(operational context validity)这一新的检索准则，并实现CASE框架，将仓库工件与运行时配置及架构演进关联，把证据分类为有效/无效/未知并生成上下文包，初步评估表明其能排除传统检索误判为可执行的16处不兼容工件，同时保留全部适用工件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体依赖检索到的代码与开发历史指导改动，但高相关性工件可能描述的是已失效或不兼容的实现。语义相似度与新近性都无法判断检索信息在特性开关、架构迁移和部署特定配置下是否仍然适用，因此需要新的检索判据。

Method: 提出运行上下文有效性准则（依赖任务、部署与时间的判据）；实现agent-agnostic的CASE框架，连接仓库工件与运行时配置及架构演进，将证据分类为valid/invalid/unknown，并生成区分可执行指导、历史依据与未解约束的上下文包；通过可复现的初步评估（6个开发任务、15个工件、3种部署）验证可行性。

Result: 传统检索将16处不兼容工件暴露为可执行信息，CASE在原型参考规则下将其排除并保留所有适用工件；新近性过滤使有效召回率降至0.43，从CASE中移除特性开关证据使召回率降至0.13。

Conclusion: 结果仅证明可行性而非编码智能体正确性的提升，但揭示了基于相关性的检索的局限，并引出新研究方向：使编码智能体不仅推理信息是否相关，还能判断其是否仍具运行有效性。

Abstract: AI coding agents increasingly rely on retrieved code and development history to guide software changes. However, highly relevant artifacts may describe implementations that are inactive or incompatible with the target deployment. Neither semantic similarity nor recency establishes whether retrieved information remains applicable under feature flags, architectural migrations, and deployment-specific configurations. We challenge relevance-oriented retrieval by introducing operational context validity, a task-, deployment-, and time-dependent criterion for determining whether software evidence can legitimately guide implementation decisions. We instantiate this new retrieval principle in CASE, an agent-agnostic framework that connects repository artifacts with runtime configurations and architectural evolution, classifies evidence as valid, invalid, or unknown, and generates context packages distinguishing actionable guidance from historical rationale and unresolved constraints. We investigate its feasibility through a reproducible preliminary evaluation involving six development tasks, 15 artifacts, and three deployments. Conventional retrieval exposes 16 incompatible artifact occurrences as actionable, whereas CASE excludes them while retaining all applicable artifacts under the prototype's reference rules. Recency filtering reduces valid recall to 0.43, while removing feature-flag evidence from CASE reduces it to 0.13. Although these results demonstrate feasibility rather than improvements in coding-agent correctness, they reveal limitations of relevance-based retrieval and motivate a new research direction: enabling coding agents to reason not only about which information is relevant, but also whether it remains operationally valid.

</details>


### [17] [Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38977)
*Prashank Kadam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 系统综述628项研究并进行受控重评估，发现多数"代码质量提升"技术仅在自身优化指标上有效；应对比预算匹配的采样基线并使用独立指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽通过功能正确性基准，但代码可读性、效率与安全性未被充分衡量；既有改进技术证据分散、多只覆盖单维度、且很少在同等算力预算下比较。

Method: (1) 系统文献综述：628篇原始研究（2021.07–2026.10），按阶段、信号来源、质量目标分类，披露LLM辅助并作者复核；(2) 受控重评估：10种技术在4个模型、预算匹配条件下评测正确性/可维护性/效率/安全性，扩展至13个模型与仓库级任务，并对66项技术在与Gemma 4 31B上做头对头比较。

Result: 单次调用下质量提示反而提高分析器告警数，复杂度与评判分数几乎不变；预算匹配时，分析器加权排序的best-of-n在排序器未优化的指标上追平或超过提示、规划、自我精修、评审agent与检索，仅分析器反馈回路与微调在告警数上胜出；HumanEval+上大幅正确性下降疑为污染与天花板效应，在训练截止后赛事题上不复现；头对头中66项仅1项超出95%区间，与随机水平一致。

Conclusion: 现有代码质量改进技术的证据多不可靠，收益常局限于自身信号；应统一以预算匹配的采样基线为参照，并在与技术信号无关的指标上报告增益。

Abstract: Large language models pass most functional-correctness benchmarks, but passing tests says little about whether their code is readable, efficient or secure. Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget. We contribute a systematic review and a controlled re-evaluation. A systematic literature review of 628 primary studies (July 2021 to October 2026), with disclosed, author-reviewed LLM assistance, organizes the techniques by stage, signal source and quality target. Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported. A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B. At one call, quality prompting raises analyzer issue counts and leaves complexity and judge scores almost unchanged. At matched budgets, best-of-n sampling with an analyzer-weighted ranker matches or beats prompting, planning, self-refinement, a reviewer agent and retrieval on measures the ranker does not optimize, while an analyzer feedback loop and fine-tuning beat it only on analyzer issue counts. Large correctness losses on HumanEval+, a likely contaminated benchmark near its ceiling, do not appear on contests held after the models' training cutoffs. In the head-to-head, 1 of 66 techniques beats best-of-n on its primary target beyond the 95% interval, a rate consistent with chance. Gains should be reported against a budget-matched sampling baseline and on measures independent of the technique's own signal.

</details>

*Prashant Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文从VAST 4.3规范中提取108条需求，在Node.js与三个引擎的五个浏览器中测试六个开源VAST客户端（八种配置）对抗69个自制测试向量与IAB样例标签，共发现78项问题、每配置3–21个must级偏差，并揭示Wrapper宏缺失、不可捕获超时异常、连播完成度归属错误及运行时依赖的合规差异，同时发布测试框架与向量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频广告通过VAST文档在流媒体与联网电视应用中投放，公司依据播放器客户端库发出的HTTP请求统计广告；跟踪错误可能不影响播放却导致后续计数不一致，因此需量化开源VAST客户端对VAST 4.3播放器职责的符合程度、结论是否随运行时变化、生成式输入的价值以及偏差的引入时间。

Result: 开源客户端共78项发现，每配置3–21个must级偏差；所有遵循Wrapper重定向链的开源客户端均未在Wrapper请求中填充必需宏，而所测归档IMA 3.794.0配置可以；某库超时抛出调用方无法捕获的异常，导致Node.js进程终止；连播场景中某播放器将结束广告的完成归因于下一条广告，已在5.3.0修复；某库在jsdom下合规，却在所有测试的Chrome与Safari系浏览器中偏差。

Conclusion: 被测客户端在用于计数与诊断广告的职责上存在分歧；在真实浏览器中运行共享一致性测试套件可暴露多数分级偏差；测试框架与向量已公开。

Abstract: Context. Video ads reach streaming and connected-TV apps through VAST documents, and companies count ads from the HTTP requests the player's client library sends. A tracking error can leave playback intact and surface later as disagreeing counts.
  Objective. To measure how far open-source VAST clients meet the player duties of VAST 4.3, whether verdicts depend on the runtime, what generated inputs add, and when deviations were introduced.
  Method. A catalog of 108 requirements was extracted from the specification. Six open-source clients in eight configurations ran against 69 crafted test vectors and the IAB's sample tags, under Node.js and in five browsers on three engines, with every request recorded. Grids, fuzzing and a sweep over 36 releases extend the catalog; Google's closed IMA SDK is a comparison.
  Results. The open-source clients have 78 findings and 3 to 21 must-level deviations per configuration. None of the tested open-source clients that follow redirect (Wrapper) chains fills the required macros in a Wrapper's request; the archived IMA 3.794.0 configuration tested does. One library's timeout throws an exception no caller can catch, ending a Node.js process. In a pod (ads played back to back), one player credits a finishing ad's completion to the next ad, fixed in release 5.3.0. A library can conform under jsdom and deviate in every tested Chrome- and Safari-family browser.
  Conclusions. The tested clients diverge on the duties other companies use to count and diagnose ads. A shared conformance suite run in real browsers could expose most graded deviations; the harness and vectors are released.

</details>


### [19] [PyReprism: A Shared Lexical Foundation for Polyglot Code Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39224)
*Daniel Ogenrwot,Jorge Gonzalo Delgado Cervantes,Richard Sserunjogi,John Businge*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: PYREPRISM 是一个开源 Python 库与命令行工具，将语言特有的词法处理与可复用分析解耦：每种语言仅声明自身词法表面以生成无损的带类型 token 流，所有分析只在该流上实现一次，从而统一多语言仓库的经验研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言（polyglot）仓库的经验研究通常对语料中每种语言施加同一套分析（如分离代码与注释、计算度量、标识符归一化、重复代码筛查），但由多个专用工具拼装会带来语言覆盖范围、度量约定与工作流上的不一致。

Method: 核心设计是"语言声明 + 共享分析"的分层：每种语言通过声明式描述其词法表面，产出无损的带类型 token 流；每项分析仅在该 token 流上实现一次，语言侧不覆盖共享分析。工具以开源 Python 库和 CLI 形式提供，内置 187 种语言；并用参考解析器在 12 种未参与分词器开发的 1,412 个文件上进行验证，另开展单仓库 trio 对比实验（匹配输入与分析操作，单核计时）。

Result: 187 种内置语言的语言特定声明中位长度仅 16 行，且无任何语言重写共享分析；在 12 种未见语言的 1,412 个文件上，注释与字符串分类相对参考解析器的 F1 分别为 0.994 与 0.958；在多语言仓库研究中，以单工具替代三个工具，匹配输入与操作下单核耗时 2.9s（对比 8.7s）。同时刻画了词法分析在复杂度估计与克隆筛查上的局限。

Conclusion: 通过"薄语言声明 + 厚共享分析"的架构，可在保持高分类精度的同时显著降低多语言工具的开发与集成成本并提升效率；但纯词法层面在复杂度估计与代码克隆筛查等任务上存在固有不足，需在更高抽象层次（如语法/语义）补充分析。

Abstract: Empirical studies of polyglot repositories apply the same analyses to every language of a corpus, such as separating code from comments, computing metrics, normalizing identifiers, and screening for duplicated code. Assembling them from specialized tools introduces differences in language coverage, measurement conventions, and workflows. We present PYREPRISM, an open-source Python library and command-line tool that separates language-specific lexical processing from reusable analyses: each language declares its lexical surface, which yields a lossless stream of typed tokens, and every analysis is implemented once on that stream. Across 187 built-in languages, language-specific declarations have a median length of 16 lines, and no language overrides a shared analysis. Against a reference parser, comment and string classification reach F1 scores of 0.994 and 0.958 on 1,412 files in 12 languages that were never used to develop the tokenizer. In a study of a polyglot repository, one tool replaces three; with matched inputs and analysis operations, it takes 2.9s instead of 8.7s on one core. We also characterize where lexical analysis falls short, in complexity estimation and clone screening. Tool: https://github.com/unlv-evol/PyReprism Video: https://youtu.be/IXc-NP5t4GU

</details>


### [20] [Omission-Safe Conditional Contracts for Evidence-Closed CI Qualification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39241)
*Zhiheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出一种"资格认定(qualification)"方法：将固定(pinned)的CI工作流在目标存在性无关的前提下编译为条件性作业需求，配合固定捕获清单与独立实现的源完备推导证书检查，实现"撤除观测事实不能产生授权"的抗遗漏性（omission resistance）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续集成证据具有条件性：工作流决定"应运行哪些作业"，而存档只记录"哪些作业仍可被观测"。若仅从观测反推需求，遗漏一份作业会连带抹除其自身应履行的义务（omission erases its own obligation），从而产生虚假的合规/授权结论。作者希望建立一种在信息缩减下仍不产生授权增量的认定框架。

Method: 1) 将pinned工作流编译为与目标存在性解耦的条件性作业需求；2) 保留固定的捕获清单(capture inventory)，避免观测驱动式裁剪；3) 由独立第二实现校验源完备的推导证书(source-complete derivation certificates)；4) 形式化论证：在sound obligations与适用性判断满足"信息扩展下保持既有真值"的条件下，撤除观测事实不能新增授权；5) 实现支持静态矩阵、依赖守卫与有界pinned可复用工作流，保留未知适用性，并区分"可容忍结果"与"证据覆盖"；6) 采用具体化消融实验：控制项、源证书攻击、proper erasure子集。

Result: 两套实现均通过45条人工规定的授权控制项；拒绝180例源证书攻击；在704例不同的proper development erasure上无任何授权增益。一个显式见证的12作业平台运行在两套实现中均获资格认定，其全部4,095个proper载荷子集erasure均阻断授权。冻结数据集覆盖6个项目、8个工作流族、240次运行；160份评测源证书全部独立验证通过，但因历史执行源身份不可得，实际资格认定仍开放。初始门控诊断在155/160次运行上一致；引入保留未知传播的修复后，回溯重跑达到160/160一致。

Conclusion: 本工作确立了有界(bounded)的源提取能力与抗遗漏性，而非自然故障的普遍性(prevalence)，也未主张产出者真实性(producer authenticity)。即其贡献在于方法学保证与可复现实验证据，而非对真实CI环境缺陷率或证据来源可信度的经验估计。

Abstract: Continuous-integration evidence is conditional: a workflow determines which jobs should run, while an archive records which jobs remain observable. Reconstructing requirements from those observations lets an omission erase its own obligation. We present a qualification method that compiles a pinned workflow into conditional job requirements independently of target presence, retains a fixed capture inventory, and checks source-complete derivation certificates with a separate implementation. For a fixed source, context, scope and binding universe, with sound obligations and applicability judgments that preserve established truth under information extension, withdrawing observation facts cannot create authorization. The implementation handles static matrices, dependency guards and bounded pinned reusable workflows, preserving unknown applicability and separating tolerated outcomes from evidence coverage. Both implementations match the 45 hand-specified authorization controls, reject 180 source-certificate attacks, and exhibit no authorization gain over 704 distinct proper development erasures. An explicitly witnessed 12-job platform run qualifies in both implementations; all 4,095 proper payload-subset erasures block authorization. A frozen collection spans 240 runs in eight workflow families across six projects. All 160 evaluation source certificates independently validate, but unavailable historical execution-source identities leave actual qualification open. Initial gate diagnoses agree on 155/160 runs; a preserved unknown-propagation repair yields 160/160 agreement in a retrospective rerun. The study establishes bounded source extraction and omission resistance, rather than natural-fault prevalence or producer authenticity.

</details>


### [21] [QSoftCore: A Conceptual Foundation for Quantum Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39406)
*Tao Yue,Yuechen Li,Man Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出概念模型QSoftCore，从软件工程视角重组既有量子计算概念，统一量子应用、算法、程序、执行与后端等指称，以支撑量子软件工程全生命周期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子软件工程（QSE）需理解应用需求、量子程序与算法、计算范式、执行与部署，但相关量子计算概念分散于物理、数学及范式特定等多个抽象层次，导致QSE社区及所提方法难以一致地引用这些概念。

Method: 构建QSoftCore概念模型，以软件工程视角重新组织已确立的量子计算概念，将量子应用、计算问题、算法、配置、程序及范式特定计算规范与状态演化、执行结果和后端相连接；并对照关键软件工程活动中的QSE文献进行评估。

Conclusion: QSoftCore可作为QSE领域的统一概念基础，缓解概念指称不一致问题，并为跨生命周期活动提供共享语义参照。

Abstract: Quantum software engineering (QSE) requires understanding application requirements, quantum programs and algorithms, quantum computation paradigms, executions, and deployment. However, relevant quantum computing (QC) concepts are often defined across physical, mathematical, and paradigm-specific levels of abstraction, making it difficult for the QSE community and hence proposed methods to refer to them consistently. Main category: cs.SE

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体已能在极少监督下进行长时、多步骤、多会话的软件工作。开发者回归时需要回答的核心问题不是"模型说了什么"，而是"实际做了什么、由谁做、是否真的完成"。现有可观测工具在证据可信度、会话衔接、回放完整性与本地安全边界上存在缺口，实践中"完成声明"与"完成证据"常被混同。

Method: 分三部分：（1）对开源本地可观测工具Agenttrail在commit e4ba2da处做源码级审计，核验文档化常量与机制、事件管线与Map服务的安全面；（2）在45个真实编码会话（102,233条记录、20,577次工具执行、2,336个人机回合）上运行系统原型，用盲审计分类器（精度83.3%与96.7%）估计行为并做置信区间推断，并用内容血缘与10分钟时间启发式对比会话配对；（3）提出Soei：确认感知事件模式、哈希链本地账本、W3C PROV对齐图、面向归属与血缘的校准推断，以及将"完成声明"与"完成证明"分离的验证层。

Conclusion: 长程智能体的可信可观测性需要以证据为中心：区分"声明完成"与"证明完成"、以内容血缘而非墙钟时间判定会话衔接、以紧凑且不含敏感内容的哈希链账本替代原始转录回放。Soei由此提供可验证、可重放、低存储放大的观测基座；作者将其与2026年并行方案对照定位，给出带证据门控的自主等级与基于本数据的测试台指标基线。

Abstract: AI coding agents now do long, multi-step and multi-session software work with little supervision. When a developer comes back to that work, the useful question is not what the model said but what was actually done, by whom, and whether it is finished. We study this in three parts. First, we verify Agenttrail, an open-source local observability tool for coding agents, against its source at commit e4ba2da: nine documented constants and mechanisms hold at file-and-line level, two event pipelines are never unified, and its Map service has an unauthenticated local mutation surface. Second, we run a prototype of our system on 45 real coding-agent sessions (102,233 records, 20,577 tool executions, 2,336 human-to-agent episodes). With a blind-audited classifier (precision 83.3% and 96.7%) we estimate that 23.4% (95% CI 17.1 to 35.7) of code-editing episodes end with no independent check after the last edit, and that 57.8% of to-dos the agent marked complete after editing had no proof in between. A 10-minute timing heuristic for session hand-offs recovers 6 of the 24 session pairs that content lineage links. 42% of sessions run longer than 24 hours, 48.1% of transcript bytes lie past a 2 MiB replay bound, and 1,326 records in 16 sessions contain credential-like strings. Third, we propose Soei (Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent): an acknowledgement-aware event schema, a hash-chained local ledger, a W3C PROV-aligned graph, calibrated inference for attribution and lineage, and a verification layer that keeps a claim of completion apart from proof. *Prateek Kumar Rajput,Yewei Song,Jacques Klein,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé*

TL;DR: 用编译器前端计算的静态分析标签（AST位置、作用域、定义-使用链、句法范畴）对冻结代码模型的每层隐状态做加性分解，并验证该分解既保留模型预测所需信息，又可通过编辑实现不重训的因果干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码语言模型的隐状态中编码了程序结构信息，但这些结构不可见、难以解释和干预。作者试图检验：编译器前端所计算的静态分析信息能否作为描述并编辑隐状态的语言。

Result: 静态分析分解在14个模型中的10个（7个代码模型中的6个）优于位置基线；删除定义-使用链在两个测试模型上消除了大部分优势；编辑分解后，StarCoder2-15B在100例中有90例输出编辑后程序的答案，位置基线仅19例。Qwen2.5系列在多项指标上是例外。

Conclusion: 对多数被测模型，标准静态分析既提供了对隐状态程序结构编码的描述，也提供了无需重训练即可修改该编码的手段；该方法的有效性依赖定义-使用等关键结构信息，且并非对所有模型族一致成立。

Abstract: Code language models complete, review, and repair programs without exposing the program structure encoded in their hidden states. In this paper, we test whether the hidden states of a code model can be described and edited using the information a compiler front end computes. For each token of a Python program, standard analyzers provide its position in the abstract syntax tree, its scope, its definition-use links, and its syntactic category. We fit a decomposition that expresses every hidden state of a frozen model as a sum of one term per token, each combining the token with this structural label, and we replace the model's own states with the decomposition at every layer while it predicts the output of a small program. If the model still answers correctly, the decomposition preserves the information the model uses. We apply this test to 14 open models, seven of them trained for code, and compare against a baseline decomposition of the same size built from token positions. The static-analysis decomposition preserves the model's answers better than the positional one in 10 of the 14 models, including six of the seven code models, and deleting the definition-use links from it removes most of that advantage on the two models tested. Editing the decomposition, for instance rebinding the argument of a call, makes StarCoder2-15B produce the answer of the edited program in 90 of 100 cases, compared with 19 for the positional baseline. The Qwen2.5 family is the exception on several measures. For most of the models tested, standard static analysis therefore provides both a description of what the hidden states encode about a program and a way to change it without retraining.

</details>

Main category: cs.SE

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态分析工具常以"不可达"的负可达性判定将安全发现从人工审查中剔除，但若该判定失准，可能漏检真实漏洞，因此需用实际执行验证其可靠性。

Result: asciinema中123个函数被判定为从入口点不可达，其中项目自带集成脚本执行了86个，全部运行共执行113个；Sublist3r中24个有19个被执行；最新Joern版本给出相同判定。缺失调用经由值传递（类、函数作为参数）或缺少调用表达式（with块、属性读取）实现，asciinema中仅4条缺失边即可使113个中的50个变为可达。手工调用图同样遗漏观测到的调用（多为属性读取和with块）。"未知"规则可恢复113个中的62个和19个中的15个，主要借助双下划线及私有方法名，但对5个负判定的安全发现恢复为0（且均位于已执行函数中）；因未执行负判定仅10个和5个，选择性无法测量，且在库入口点模型下每个负判定都退化。

Conclusion: 基于Joern调用图的负可达性判定与执行显著不符，可能错误剔除应审查的发现；简单放宽规则收益有限且损害精确性，负可达性不应作为剔除安全发现的充分依据。

Abstract: A negative reachability verdict removes a finding from human review. We check such verdicts against execution. Our pipeline, SourceLens, maps Semgrep findings to a Python program's call graph, whose edges a query takes from the calls that Joern links in its code property graph. We ran two command-line programs from the PyCG macro-benchmark, in which the benchmark's manual call graph and Joern disagree, under coverage and recorded the calls between their functions. On these edges, 123 functions of asciinema are unreachable from the program's entry points. The project's own integration script executes 86 of them, and all our runs 113. In Sublist3r, 19 of 24 are executed. The latest Joern release gives the same verdicts. The missing calls go through values, such as classes and functions passed around, or have no call expression, as in with blocks and property reads. In asciinema, four missing edges make 50 of the 113 executed functions reachable. The manual call graphs also lack observed calls, in asciinema many of them property reads and with blocks, which the benchmark may not count as calls. A rule that turns negative verdicts into unknown recovers 62 of the 113 and 15 of the 19, mostly through dunder and private method names. It recovers 0 of the 5 security findings with a negative verdict, all in executed functions. Its selectivity cannot be measured, as only 10 and 5 negative verdicts were not executed, and under library entry-point models it degrades every negative verdict.

</details>


### [26] [Lost in the Latent Space: How Code Embeddings Represent Functional Intent and Implementation Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39519)
*Lu Sun,Yuheng Huang,Lei Ma,Zhijie Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 大规模实证研究14个SOTA代码嵌入模型，揭示"抽象性-保真度"张力，表明单一通用代码表示难以实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码嵌入模型广泛用于软件工程，但内部表示理解不足；现有评估只看下游任务性能，无法判断单一嵌入能否同时支持功能抽象与实现敏感分析。

Method: 对14个SOTA代码嵌入模型做三类互补分析：(1)监督探针评估功能抽象与实现保真度；(2)零样本检索评估几何相似性；(3)受控扰动实验测量对语义保持代码变换的嵌入响应。

Result: 发现一致的"抽象性-保真度"张力：更能保留风格与结构信号的模型以语义泛化为代价；检索性能相近的模型对同一实现变更的响应可能差异很大。

Conclusion: 单一通用代码表示尚不可行，需在软件工程中开展更具表示感知性的评估、选择与部署。

Abstract: Code embedding models have become a key building block for many software engineering applications, yet their internal representations remain poorly understood. Existing evaluations tend to focus on downstream task performance, offering limited insight into whether a single embedding can support both functional abstraction and implementation-sensitive analysis. To address this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of 14 state-of-the-art code embedding models. We evaluate their representational behavior through three complementary analyses: supervised probing for functional abstraction and implementation fidelity, zero-shot retrieval experiments to assess geometric similarity, and controlled perturbation experiments that measure embedding responses to semantics-preserving code transformations. The results reveal a consistent abstraction-fidelity tension: models that better preserve stylistic and structural signals tend to do so at the expense of semantic generalization, while models with similar retrieval performance can nevertheless respond very differently to the same implementation changes. Overall, our findings suggest that a single universal code representation remains out of reach, motivating more representation-aware evaluation, selection, and deployment of code embedding models in software engineering.

</details>


### [27] [Early Prediction of Cross-Service Implementation Scope: Evidence and Limits from Multiple Microservice Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39640)
*Zhoumaocuo,Xiaozhou Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究基于13个开源微服务项目的866个可追溯特性请求，考察能否在实现前预测跨服务改动范围。结果表明跨服务改动仅占11.7%，实现前证据仅提供有限的跨服务预测信号（最优LOSO模型项目宏Macro-F1为0.484且经Holm校正后不显著），下游工作量估计更难，简单服务提及启发式与学习型模型相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微服务架构旨在将变更局部化，但特性请求的实现往往需要跨越服务边界，形成下游影响范围（downstream scope）。作者希望探究：在实现开始之前，能否基于早期特性请求证据预期这种跨服务范围，并评估自动化范围判定与工作量估计的可行性。

Method: 利用issue–pull-request–commit的追溯关系，并经定向人工裁决修正实现证据，从13个开源微服务项目中重建866个仓库可追溯的特性请求，并将实现映射到经验证的服务边界。以跨服务改动为标签，评估实现前证据的预测能力：采用留一系统（leave-one-system-out, LOSO）交叉验证、项目宏（project-macro）Macro-F1指标、Holm多重比较校正，并与多数类基线、简单服务提及启发式及本地LLM进行对比；工作量估计则以训练折中位数为基线。

Result: 101个请求（11.7%）存在跨服务改动，其实现足迹更广、代码churn更高，但前置时间（lead time）无明显差异。实现前证据的跨项目预测信号有限：最强LOSO模型项目宏Macro-F1为0.484，但相对多数类基线的优势经Holm校正后不显著，且对小型评估折敏感。本地LLM未带来可靠提升。下游工作量显著更难估计，学习模型不能稳定优于训练折中位数基线；简单服务提及启发式与学习型范围分诊表现相当。

Conclusion: 早期特性请求证据更适用于轻量级的跨服务范围分诊（scope triage），而非自动化的范围判定或精确工作量估计。研究提示应以辅助性、轻量化的方式使用早期证据，避免过度承诺自动预测能力。

Abstract: Microservice architectures aim to localize change, yet feature requests may require implementation across service boundaries. We investigate how well such downstream scope can be anticipated before implementation begins. Using issue--pull-request--commit traceability and implementation evidence corrected through targeted human adjudication, we reconstruct 866 repository-traceable feature requests from 13 open-source microservice projects and map their implementations to validated service boundaries. Cross-service changes occur in 101 requests (11.7%) and exhibit broader implementation footprints, particularly higher code churn, but no clear difference in lead time. Pre-implementation evidence provides limited cross-project predictive signal: the strongest leave-one-system-out model reaches a project-macro Macro-F1 of 0.484, but its advantage over the majority baseline is not significant after Holm correction and is sensitive to small evaluation folds. A local LLM offers no reliable improvement over classical models. Downstream workload is substantially harder to estimate, as learned models do not consistently outperform training-fold median baselines. A simple service-mention heuristic also performs comparably to learned scope triage. These findings show that early feature-request evidence is more useful for lightweight cross-service scope triage than for automated scope determination or precise workload estimation.

</details>


### [28] [STORY2DIFF: A Dataset Linking Real-World User Stories to Code Changes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39872)
*Benedetta Donato,Daniele Franchini,Alessandro Greco,Oliviero Riganelli,Daniela Micucci,Leonardo Mariani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出STORY2DIFF数据集，包含7,785条英文用户故事及其对应的已合并Pull Request代码变更，用于支撑需求到代码相关研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求到代码任务需要"真实需求—实现变更"配对的样本，但现有用户故事数据集多为孤立或合成文本，缺乏与代码变更的真实链接。

Method: 从982个公开Java和Python仓库中挖掘2017年1月至2026年7月的用户故事，将其与已合并的Pull Request关联；每条记录包含原始Issue、抽取的Connextra要素、关联PR与提交元数据、文件级diff以及变更前后的受影响文件；并提供可复用的挖掘工具以支持不同参数（如不同时间范围）下的自动抽取。

Result: 构建了包含7,785条英文用户故事与合并PR配对的数据集，并公开工具与视频；数据集可用于需求发现、可追溯性、变更影响估计及需求感知的代码生成等任务。

Conclusion: STORY2DIFF弥补了现有用户故事数据集缺乏真实代码链接的不足，为需求到代码研究提供了大规模、可复现、多任务适用的基准资源。

Abstract: Research on requirements-to-code tasks needs examples in which a genuine requirement is paired with the change that implemented it. Existing user-story collections, however, largely contain isolated or synthetic text. To address this limitation, we present STORY2DIFF, a dataset of 7,785 English user stories linked to merged pull requests from January 2017 to July 2026. The dataset is mined from a set of 982 public Java and Python repositories. Each record in the dataset combines the original issue, extracted Connextra elements, the associated pull request and commit metadata, a file-level diff capturing the code changes introduced by the associated pull request, and the affected files before and after the change. The tool we built to mine STORY2DIFF can be used to repeat the automatic extraction of the records, using different parameters (e.g., a different timeframe). The dataset can support a variety of tasks, including requirement discovery, traceability, change- impact estimation, and requirements-aware code generation. Dataset: https://github.com/riganelli/user-story-mining-pipeline/ releases/tag/V4.0.1. Video: https://youtu.be/qOhXUeyeiTQ.

</details>

*Benedetta Donato,Leonardo Mariani,Daniela Micucci,Oliviero Riganelli*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出PR4Code数据集，包含从GitHub采集的4,508个Java和8,831个Python Pull Request，每个PR附带元数据、提交历史与详细代码改动，用于评估AI驱动的完整软件功能实现任务。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代码生成正从小规模局部代码补全转向支持完整软件功能实现，但现有资源多聚焦于孤立代码片段，缺乏能刻画功能实现过程的真实开发任务集合，因此需要构建覆盖完整PR的真实世界数据集。

Conclusion: PR4Code为评估AI驱动的完整功能实现方案提供了贴近真实开发流程的基准资源，并通过可复现流程支撑后续维护与扩展。

Abstract: AI-driven code generation is evolving from handling small, localized code-completion tasks toward supporting the implementation of full software features. To support this transition, this paper introduces PR4Code, a dataset of 4,508 Java and 8,831 Python curated Pull Requests (PRs) collected from GitHub, each enriched with metadata, commit histories, and detailed code changes. Unlike resources focused on isolated code fragments, PR4Code captures the feature implementation process, delivering a large and diverse collection of real-world development tasks that can be used to assess AI-driven solutions. Our analysis reveals substantial variability in PR structure, commit granularity, and textual content. In addition, we release scripts to regenerate and update the dataset, ensuring reproducibility and maintainability.

</details>
