*Duc Manh Tran,Ratnadira Widyasari,Ivana Clairine Irsan,Huihui Huang,Ting Zhang,David Lo,Rahul Gopinath,Hong Jin Kang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 ExploreRepair 框架，通过多智能体探索漏洞的不同解释并进行提案调和，在信息不完整（缺少漏洞分类或 PoV 测试）条件下实现自动化漏洞修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际场景中开发者常缺乏准确的漏洞分类或可用的 PoV 测试，信息不完整使得修复困难；关键挑战在于提交修复前需探索漏洞的多种可能解释。

Method: 三个探索智能体各自从特定维度探索漏洞并给出观察与修复实现；随后 Lesson Aggregator 与 Patch Aggregator 分别基于观察和具体实现独立合成修复方案；最后由 Final Aggregator 在无基准反馈条件下调和两者的提案。

Result: PatchEval 上，GPT-5.6-Luna 与 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 的成功率分别为 39.6% 与 71.6%，较 SOTA 方法 EvoRepair 提升 16.0 与 25.4 个百分点；VulnLoc+ 上成功率分别为 51.4% 与 62.9%，较无 PoV 测试的 LoopRepair 变体提升 20.0 与 17.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 多智能体探索与双层聚合机制可有效应对漏洞信息不完整的修复场景，且无需基准反馈即可显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Automated vulnerability repair must often operate with incomplete vulnerability information: developers may lack an accurate vulnerability classification or a provided proof-of-vulnerability (PoV) test, yet still need to produce a repair. Without detailed information, a key challenge is to explore multiple plausible interpretations of the vulnerability before committing to a repair. To address this challenge, we propose ExploreRepair, a vulnerability repair framework that reconciles the vulnerability observations and repair implementations from a team of exploration agents. We first collect these observations and repair implementations from three agents, each tasked with exploring a specific dimension of the vulnerability. Then, a Lesson Aggregator and a Patch Aggregator independently synthesize repairs from these observations and concrete implementations before a final Aggregator reconciles their proposals without benchmark feedback. On PatchEval, ExploreRepair achieves repair success rates of 39.6% and 71.6% with GPT-5.6-Luna and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively, exceeding EvoRepair, a state-of-the-art vulnerability repair approach, by 16.0 and 25.4 percentage points. On VulnLoc+, it achieves success rates of 51.4% and 62.9%, respectively, exceeding LoopRepair's variant without PoV tests by 20.0 and 17.1 percentage points.

</details>


### [31] [UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40042)
*Peter Dolog,Kim G. Larsen,Marius Mikučionis,Frederik F. K. Rasmussen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: UPPAAI 将大语言模型接入 UPPAAL，通过 Tools API 暴露编辑器、查询与验证器，实现"用户请求、LLM 提议/解释/编排、UPPAAL 验证"的对话式建模与验证流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UPPAAL 三十余年来支持实时与信息物理系统建模分析，但构建合适模型、形式化目标性质、选择分析技术、解读反例仍是高度依赖专家、需反复迭代的任务。LLM 能给出看似合理的解释甚至方案，却不保证正确，因此需要把 LLM 的生成能力与模型检查器的严格验证结合起来。

Method: 提出 UPPAAI，作为 UPPAAL 的扩展，使用户能以对话方式构建、解释、调试和规约模型。核心设计原则为分工：用户提出请求，LLM 负责提议、解释与编排工具调用，UPPAAL 负责验证。实现上通过 Tools API 将 UPPAAL 编辑器、查询与验证器暴露给 LLM。

Result: 报告了七个案例研究，涵盖从向新手讲解到学习控制器，覆盖时间自动机、随机混合自动机与策略学习。LLM 不仅在生成方案上有帮助，还会主动建议用户未提及的相关 UPPAAL 特性。

Conclusion: 将 LLM 定位为"提议与编排者"、把正确性判定交给形式验证工具，是可行且有效的交互范式；但 LLM 输出本身不可信，其价值在于加速迭代与降低使用门槛，而非替代验证。

Abstract: For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. LLMs proved to be extremely helpful in not just generating solutions but also pro-actively suggesting relevant UPPAAL features it was not asked about.

</details>


### [32] [Unraveling the Efficacy of Neuron Coverage Criteria on Testing Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40234)
*Xiaoning Ren,Jiayang Song,Chongyang Liu,Jie Li,Lei Ma,Yinxing Xue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了六种神经元覆盖准则（四种经典+两种近期）在仅编码器、仅解码器和编码器-解码器三大类Transformer语言模型上的有效性，从错误揭示能力、分布多样性、样本公平性和测试输入生成指导四个维度进行衡量。结果显示覆盖准则在多样性评估上有效，但在揭示对抗性错误上作用有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经元覆盖准则被广泛用于评估测试集质量和指导测试输入生成，但其在基于Transformer的语言模型上是否有效尚不清楚。作者希望厘清这些准则在Transformer架构下的真实作用边界，以避免误用并推动更适配的准则设计。

Method: 在仅编码器、仅解码器和编码器-解码器三类Transformer模型上评估六种覆盖准则（四种成熟准则+两种近期准则），从四个方面考察：错误揭示能力、分布多样性、样本公平性（类别多样性）以及对测试输入生成的指导作用；并通过将神经元级覆盖指导引入测试输入生成来量化其增益。

Result: 有效性表现不均衡：错误样本相对噪声样本仅带来0.32%的额外覆盖率，说明对对抗性错误敏感度有限；而覆盖准则在33种配置中分别有26种和30种能有效评估分布多样性和样本公平性；将神经元级覆盖指导纳入测试输入生成，仅使对抗样本产量提升4.56%。

Conclusion: 现有覆盖准则可作为评估多样性的"解药"，但在揭示对抗性错误方面基本是"安慰剂"，单独使用时尤为明显。其实际价值取决于有限收益是否抵得上测试大型Transformer模型的计算开销。研究呼吁设计更鲁棒、更高效、具备更强错误揭示能力且对测试生成更有价值的Transformer专用覆盖准则。

Abstract: Neuron coverage criteria aim to assess test suite quality and guide test input generation, but their effectiveness for Transformer-based language models remains unclear. We evaluate six criteria, including four established and two recent criteria, across encoder-only, decoder-only, and encoder-decoder models. Our evaluation examines error-revealing capability, distribution diversity, sample fairness (category diversity), and guidance for test input generation. The results reveal uneven effectiveness. Erroneous samples provide only 0.32% additional coverage over noise samples, indicating limited sensitivity to adversarial errors. By contrast, coverage criteria effectively assess distribution diversity and sample fairness in 26 and 30 of 33 configurations, respectively. Incorporating neuron-wise coverage guidance into test input generation increases adversarial sample production by only 4.56%. These findings suggest that existing coverage criteria can serve as an antidote for assessing diversity but remain largely a placebo for revealing adversarial errors, particularly when used individually. Their practical value therefore depends on whether these limited benefits justify the computational overhead of testing large Transformer-based models. Our study highlights the need for more robust and efficient coverage criteria tailored to these models, with stronger error-revealing capability and greater value for test generation.

</details>


### [33] [When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40256)
*Yishuo Cai,Minzheng Wang,Liang Zhao,Linghao Zhang,Lei Li,Shicheng Li,Xu Sun,Fuli Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 CodeSpecWeave 框架，通过合成智能体迭代生成耦合的任务需求与可执行测试、并由审查智能体审计多模型轨迹以保证测试可靠性，从真实开发种子构建了 4,670 个训练任务（覆盖 2,865 个仓库）；在该数据上做强化学习显著优于基线模型，并构建含 100 任务、1,044 条规格的 CodeSpecWeave-Bench 以区分前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实长程软件开发的编码智能体需同时满足接口兼容、错误处理等多维规格且不破坏既有依赖，而现有数据在规格的数量与多样性上均不足，往往只强调主要目标、忽视复杂约束。合成此类任务面临两大挑战：简单堆叠规格会使任务退化为琐碎清单、难以触发联合推理；而验证规格间细微交互又易漏检缺陷或误拒合法解法。

Method: 以真实开发者种子为起点，采用双智能体流水线：合成智能体迭代式地协同发展相互耦合的任务需求与可执行测试；审查智能体基于多个模型的解题轨迹进行审计，以保障测试可靠性，从而合成规格丰富且相互依赖的任务。

Result: 构建了 4,670 个训练任务，覆盖 2,865 个代码仓库；在这些任务上应用强化学习，使基础模型在 DeepSWE-v1.1 上的性能显著提升，并大幅超越现有基线。另整理出 CodeSpecWeave-Bench，包含 100 个任务与 1,044 条规格，可清晰区分前沿模型，并揭示其在处理相互依赖的工程约束上仍有显著提升空间。

Conclusion: 以“耦合需求—可执行测试”联合合成加多模型轨迹审计为核心的 CodeSpecWeave，可规模化生产高规格密度的训练数据，有效提升编码智能体的长程多约束能力；同时表明相互依赖的工程约束仍是当前前沿模型的明显短板，具备较大研究空间。

Abstract: To succeed in real-world long-horizon software development, coding agents must satisfy multi-dimensional task specifications, such as interface compatibility and error handling, and do so without breaking existing dependencies. However, current works lack specification in both quantity and diversity, often emphasizing primary goals while ignoring complex constraints. Synthesizing tasks to bridge this gap presents two challenges: naively adding specifications risks reducing tasks to trivial checklists rather than compelling joint reasoning, and verifying these subtle interactions risks overlooking hidden flaws or rejecting valid alternatives. To address these challenges, we introduce CodeSpecWeave, a framework for synthesizing tasks with rich, interdependent specifications. Grounded in real developer seeds, a synthesis agent iteratively develops both coupled task requirements and executable tests, while a review agent audits solution trajectories from multiple models to guarantee test reliability. Using this pipeline, we construct 4,670 training tasks across 2,865 repositories. Applying Reinforcement learning on these tasks significantly improves performance over the base model on DeepSWE-v1.1, largely outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we curate CodeSpecWeave-Bench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 100 tasks and 1,044 specifications, which clearly separates frontier models and reveals significant headroom in handling interdependent engineering constraints.

</details>


### [34] [When Modernization Breaks Working Code: A Single-File Study of LLMs on Legacy PHP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40269)
*Afridi Mahmud,Abid Hasan Khondaker,Sadif Ahmed,Md Nafiu Rahman,Rifat Shahriyar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文考察"将单个遗留 PHP 文件直接交给 LLM 现代化"这一捷径：5 个 LLM 各自把 100 个 WordPress 4.0 的 PHP 文件改写为 PHP 8.3 且不提供项目上下文与执行反馈。用 630 项隐藏行为检查与 511 条 Rector 现代化发现评估。结论大多是否定的：未修改的 83 个文件全部通过检查，最佳 LLM 仅剩 59 个；模型修复极少却破坏大量可用文件，且多数破坏并非 PHP 8.3 所必需。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "把遗留文件粘进 LLM 让它现代化"被当作低成本捷径，但其收益缺少与"不改动"基线及规则工具（Rector）的严格对照。作者要回答：LLM 的现代化结果是否真的优于保持原状，并据此提出评估方法论。

Method: 单文件设定、无项目上下文、无执行反馈；5 个 LLM，各处理 100 个 WordPress 4.0 PHP 文件并迁移至 PHP 8.3，要求保持行为不变。评估用 630 项隐藏行为检查（behavioral preservation）与 511 条 Rector 检测的现代化发现（modernization）两套独立指标，并与两个基线比较：未改动的原始文件、规则工具 Rector。此外区分"PHP 8.3 下必需修改"的 37 条发现与"无需修改即可兼容"的文件，量化无谓改动造成的破坏。

Result: 原始未改文件中 83/100 个通过全部检查，最佳 LLM 仅 59 个。每个模型破坏 32–51 个原本可用的文件，而最多修复 10 个；Rector 破坏 7 个、修复 6 个。仅 37 条发现（7%）在 PHP 8.3 下必须修改，但在无需任何修改的兼容文件中，LLM 仍破坏 36%–60%（Rector 为 8%）。现代化得分最高的模型其兼容性并不优于最接近的竞争者。多数回归检查源自文件完全无法加载，常因类型声明被 PHP 本身拒绝——这类错误无需项目上下文即可避免。

Conclusion: LLM 单文件"现代化"往往得不偿失。评估 LLM 现代化应（1）以"不改动"为基线对照，（2）分别报告现代化程度与行为保持率，而非用单一聚合分数掩盖破坏。

Abstract: Pasting a legacy file into an LLM and asking it to "modernize this" is an easy shortcut. But is the result better than leaving the code alone? In this paper, we study this single-file setting with five LLMs, each asked to modernize 100 WordPress 4.0 PHP files to PHP 8.3 while preserving behavior, with no project context or execution feedback. We evaluate every output with 630 hidden behavioral checks and 511 Rector-detected modernization findings. We compare against two baselines: the unchanged originals and the rule-based tool Rector. Often, the answer is no. Untouched, 83 files already pass every check; the best LLM leaves only 59. Each model breaks 32-51 working files while repairing at most 10, whereas Rector breaks 7 and repairs 6. Most of this damage is unnecessary. Only 37 findings (7 percent) require a change under PHP 8.3, yet in compatible files with no required change, the LLMs break 36-60 percent (Rector: 8 percent). The model with the highest modernization score is no more compatible than its closest competitors. Most regressed checks come from files that no longer load at all, often because of type declarations PHP itself rejects. These are errors that need no project context to avoid. Evaluations of LLM-based modernization should therefore measure against a no-change baseline and report modernization and behavioral preservation separately.

</details>


### [35] [Manual binding and semi-automated interface generation for efficient simulation backends with user-friendly frontends: A~demonstration for epidemic use cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40343)
*Maximilian Betz,Daniel-Michel Richter,Daniel Abele,René Schmieding,Henrik Zunker,Martin J. Kühn*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文讨论数学软件中编程语言选择带来的性能与易用性矛盾，提出将大型传染病建模框架（C/C++后端）高效暴露给Python，并采用基于抽象语法树（AST）的半自动化接口代码生成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学软件面临的挑战与所用编程语言紧密相关：脚本语言（Python/R）门槛低、便于快速原型与交互开发，但详细仿真难以保证时效；已有多项应用表明C/C++实现比纯Python/R快1至3个数量级。在传染病建模尤其是大流行期间，对系统动态的快速估计需求迫切，使非编译语言的大规模模型不可行。同时，迭代式模型开发中手工编写绑定库会为C/C++后端开发者带来新的障碍，需要弥合应用领域与计算领域科学家之间的鸿沟。

Method: 通过绑定库将完整编译的软件框架从Python调用；进一步提出半自动化的接口代码生成方法——借助抽象语法树（AST）分析通用C++代码，基于中间表示实现模块化的绑定生成，以降低后端开发者维护绑定的负担。

Result: 论文展示了如何将包含多种传染病模型的大型软件框架高效地暴露给Python，并验证了通过AST分析自动生成接口代码的可行性，从而在保留C/C++性能的同时提供Python的易用性与交互性。

Conclusion: 编译型后端与脚本型前端的结合是兼顾性能与开发效率的有效途径；基于AST的半自动化绑定生成可显著降低接口维护成本，支持模块化、可迭代的模型开发与扩展，为传染病建模等对时效敏感的应用提供可行方案。

Abstract: Challenges and chances of mathematical software are directly entangled with the programming language used. Depending on the background of developers and users, conflicts between different goals may arise. While several, e.g., scripting languages allow a low barrier and user-friendly entry to mathematical modeling and simulation, corresponding implementations will most likely not allow timely outcomes for detailed simulations.
  In infectious disease modeling, while several large-scale software frameworks rely on C or C++ implementations, most models are implemented in Python or R. While the latter allow for fast prototyping and more interactive development, it has been shown for several applications that C or C++ implementations outperform plain Python or R implementations by factors between one and three orders of magnitude. In particular, in times of pandemics, the urgent need for swift estimation of the system's dynamics makes the use of large-scale models in these noncompiled languages prohibitive.
  In order to create synergies and close the gap between scientists from the application and the computational domain, binding libraries allow to execute entire, compiled software frameworks from languages such as Python. However, with iterative model development, extension, or addition of new models, implementing bindings can represent another relevant barrier to developers of the C or C++ backends. In this paper, we show how a large-scale software framework with a multitude of infectious disease models can be efficiently exposed to Python. In addition, we suggest a semi-automated way to generate interface code by analyzing generic C++ code through abstract syntax trees, enabling a modularized approach working with intermediate representations.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026年9月新大模型发布后，"让模型写程序、程序生成视频"的"一键视频"大量涌现。主流解读停留在"个体创作力提升"的表层，作者认为这只看到了表象，真正的变化在于内容产业结构被重塑，因此需要从结构层面给出解释与预警，并探讨应对机制。

Result: 在给定条件成立时，简化模型表明：随新内容量增长超过某一倍数，推荐池（层层试看）机制将失效——试看所消耗的注意力不足以支撑对候选池的有效甄别，且优质内容被稀释。分配机制上，服务型内容可由机器与准入规则把关，作品型内容则需可信赖的人来评判。

Conclusion: "一键视频"不是单纯的个体创作力提升，而是内容产业的结构性转变：服务型与作品型内容比例失衡，加上注意力总量固定与推荐池筛选机制，共同导致平台推荐机制在规模化生成内容下失效。作者提出BoLe系统作为可能出路——机器与准入规则负责服务型内容的质量门槛，可信赖的人负责作品型内容的评判——并展望两类内容的未来演化路径。

Abstract: In September 2026, a new large language model was released. Soon after, a new way of making explainer videos became very popular: people asked the model to write a program, and the program produced the video. "One-click video" content then appeared in large amounts on many platforms. On the surface, this is a rise in creative power at the level of the individual. We argue that, at a deeper level, it changes the structure of the content industry. This judgment rests on two observations. First, this wave of content is service-type content. People watch it to meet a need, not to enjoy the content itself. The other kind is work-type content. AI makes both kinds faster to produce. But anyone can come in and make service-type content, while work-type content is limited by the number of people who have something to say. So the ratio between the two slowly becomes unbalanced. Second, free platforms choose content through layers of trial viewing, and this uses up user attention. The total amount of attention is fixed. The unbalanced ratio also dilutes good content. A simplified mathematical model shows that, as long as these conditions hold, the recommendation pool mechanism will fail once new content grows past a certain multiple. Based on this, we discuss one possible way out. Machines and entry rules judge whether service-type content passes the bar. Trusted people judge work-type content. We call this the BoLe system. At the end, we briefly imagine how the two kinds of content may develop from here.

</details>

Abstract: Large scientific collaborations produce extensive internal documentation spread across heterogeneous systems, making it difficult for collaborators to locate and reuse existing knowledge. We present chATLAS, a deployed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant developed for the ATLAS experiment at CERN. The system provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources, material largely unavailable to general-purpose language models, using hybrid dense--sparse retrieval deployed on CERN infrastructure. A domain-specific benchmark built from automatically generated question--answer pairs is used to evaluate retrieval and generation performance and to guide design choices. We study the selection and domain-specific fine-tuning of an embedding model, contextual retrieval, ranking strategies, and generator choice. Fine-tuning combined with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source. The deployed system also includes intent routing, safety handling, Mattermost integration, and an MCP server for future agentic workflows. chATLAS demonstrates that domain-adapted RAG can provide source-attributed, domain-specific access to collaboration knowledge, and offers a practical foundation for scientific collaborations and other organisations that rely on accurate, up-to-date retrieval from proprietary documentation.

</details>

Main category: cs.IR

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Large language models with retrieval-augmented generation systematically underutilize evidence in the middle of multi-document contexts, a phenomenon known as Lost in the Middle. Existing mitigation strategies, such as document reordering and attention steering, can reduce boundary bias but remain brittle in noisy settings, where inaccurate relevance estimation and spurious documents still obscure useful evidence in central positions. We propose DuQUAD, a multi-document QA framework that mitigates positional bias through dual-view reasoning and quality-aware evidence pruning. DuQUAD combines a Local Agent guided by a Structural Fusion Score with a Global Agent that reasons over the full document set, providing both targeted evidence recovery and broad contextual understanding. The framework further filters candidate evidence using explicit quality scoring and refines it at the sentence level to reduce noise. DuQUAD consistently outperforms strong Lost-in-the-Middle mitigation baselines, including hybrid retrieval and reranking, multi-agent reasoning, and context optimization methods, improving accuracy by 3.0% on average over the strongest competing baseline and gold evidence recall by 9.4%, while substantially reducing computational cost compared to existing multi-agent frameworks.

</details>


### [39] [Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration for Spectral Compression of Dense Retrieval Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37707)
*Yongkang Li,Panagiotis Eustratiadis,Evangelos Kanoulas*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC)，一种闭式方法，利用相关性判断对谱压缩（PCA/Whitening/SpecTemp）的谱权重进行逐方向细化，在保留压缩器整体谱趋势的同时提升检索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱压缩通过将嵌入投影到较小的主子空间来降低稠密检索的存储与打分成本，但其基于语料库的加权规则把所有保留方向绑定到一个共享的谱趋势上，未直接考虑各方向对相关性的个体贡献。

Method: RRC 沿每个保留方向，基于正负样本得分贡献的均值与方差估计 margin-based 权重；保留估计权重为正的方向，将其对数权重分解为拟合的幂律趋势与残差，并在该支撑集上将残差加至压缩器的对数权重。该修正并入文档与查询共享的现有变换，无需迭代训练或额外推理阶段，适用于 PCA、Whitening、SpecTemp。

Conclusion: 相关性引导的残差校准可在不改动压缩器整体谱结构的前提下实现逐方向自适应调整，是一种免训练、无额外推理开销且可广泛适配现有谱压缩器的有效改进方案。

Abstract: Spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. However, its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend, without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. To address this, we propose Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC), a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. RRC estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. It retains directions with positive estimated weights, decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual, and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. This allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. RRC applies to PCA, Whitening, and SpecTemp, and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries, without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. Experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that SpecTemp + RRC achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the BEIR group and BRIGHT at every target dimension. On the five evaluated BRIGHT datasets, it improves over SpecTemp by an average of 2.34 nDCG@10 points at 768 dimensions. The gains also persist under scalar and product quantization, improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/

</details>

*Fakabbir Amin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文探究在企业级RAG场景下，用知识图谱存储元数据与频繁变动信息是否优于基于嵌入向量的相似度检索。研究者构建SEC EDGAR季度快照（167,050份文件、10,511家公司、508,714个嵌入块）及含430,257节点、561,144条边的知识图谱，对比text-to-SQL、稠密向量RAG（HNSW余弦）与两阶段GraphRAG三种架构。结果显示GraphRAG在20题三次尝试中解决16题，远优于text-to-SQL的10题与向量RAG的3题。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业文档由多团队长期创建，无法用组织职责范围外的最新信息与元数据加以丰富，这构成RAG系统的核心挑战。研究者希望验证以知识图谱承载元数据与高频变动信息，能否改善相对于嵌入相似度检索的知识检索效果。

Conclusion: 在本文语料、模型与问题集范围内，基于知识图谱的设计显著优于向量相似度检索与text-to-SQL，尤其体现在身份归属与单文档检索上；但作者明确声明该优势不外推至本语料、本模型与本问题集之外，且GraphRAG在结构化聚合查询上仍存在不足。

Abstract: A key challenge of RAG systems is retrieving information from enterprise documents created by multiple teams over time, where it is not possible to enrich the information using the latest information and metadata available outside the scope of organizational documentation responsibility. We investigated whether using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information would improve upon knowledge retrieval over similarity search over embeddings. To perform the experiment, we created a snapshot of the SEC EDGAR dataset for a quarter, comprising 167,050 filings from 10,511 companies and 508,714 embedded chunks of risk-factor text. To simulate the enrichment, we created a knowledge graph of 430,257 nodes and 561,144 edges carrying an accession number on every edge. To evaluate the gain obtained via a graph-based design, we evaluated three architectures: text-to-SQL over typed columns, dense-vector RAG with HNSW cosine search, and a two-stage GraphRAG design. All architectures share the same model and temperature to allow comparison. Results are scored programmatically by an LLM as judge over 20 questions divided across four categories, each question asked three times. GraphRAG solved 16 of 20 questions on all three attempts, compared to 10 for text-to-SQL and 3 for vector RAG. GraphRAG lost on structured aggregation queries. Vector RAG lost the single-document category it was expected to win, passing 3 of 15 where GraphRAG passed 15 of 15, because company attribution is not recoverable from cosine similarity at this scale. All six confident falsehoods in the benchmark were text-to-SQL conflating distinct people who share a surname, the failure that resolving identity to an identifier before reading any text prevents structurally; GraphRAG made none. We claim no advantage beyond this corpus, this model and this question set.

</details>

*Carlos Peláez-González,Francisco Herrera,Andrés Herrera-Poyatos*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文研究单轮、top-1的LLM推荐系统中候选呈现顺序导致的系统性位置偏置，提出POB-ICM（列联表+卡方独立性检验）与POB-UNBP（基于均匀零模型的置换检验、样本高效且支持随机解码）两种检测方法，并在受控RAG测试床上验证偏置存在、给出三种量化指标，主张常规审计与顺序随机化等治理措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为RAG式推荐生成器虽灵活，却引入新的结构性偏置来源；其中提示中候选排列顺序对推荐结果的影响尚未被系统刻画与统计检验，缺少可复现的检测方法与量化指标。

Result: 在所有评估的SOTA模型中，两种方法均在统计上拒绝位置独立性与均匀性原假设；偏置为结构性且模型相关，并非确定性解码或候选集规模的伪影；强位置偏置表明位置可使推荐转向明显更不相关的条目。

Conclusion: 位置偏置是提示中介推荐流水线中可测量、可复现的属性，应纳入常规审计与治理控制（如顺序随机化、标准化提示）；代码已公开。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. Using a controlled RAG testbed for product recommendation, built on a real product catalog, a fixed prompt template and 2000 template-generated user queries with 20 permutations each (40,000 instances), both methodologies reject the null hypothesis of positional independence and uniformity in all evaluated state-of-the-art models. We introduce three complementary metrics -- permutation sensitivity, positional bias, and strong positional bias -- to quantify this effect, the latter targeting cases where the position displaces the recommendation towards clearly less relevant items rather than only choosing among comparably relevant ones. A robustness analysis across candidate-set size and decoding temperature shows that the bias is structural and model-dependent, not an artifact of deterministic decoding or candidate-set size. These results establish positional bias as a measurable, reproducible property of prompt-mediated recommendation pipelines in the evaluated setting and motivate routine auditing and governance controls (e.g., order randomization, standardized prompting) for deployed LLM-based RS. Source code is publicly released.

</details>


### [42] [Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37973)
*Yunqin Zhu,Yao Xie*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: M&B通过“合并”历史项（SID+文本压缩为少量学习token）与“分支”（用压缩历史预测多个目标SID），把输入成本降下来并让单次历史编码获得多重监督；配套树形FlashAttention与树形KV cache实现训练与解码的高效共享。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的生成式推荐需读取长而富文本的交互历史，却仅生成很短的语义标识符（SID），这种不对称使监督微调低效：历史编码昂贵，而每条历史通常只提供一个目标的监督信号。

Method: 提出Merge and Branch（M&B）：Merge将每个历史项的SID与文本压缩为少量可学习token；Branch用压缩后的历史同时预测多个目标SID。为在共享历史计算的同时保持各目标独立，将每个样本组织为浅而宽的树结构；设计tree FlashAttention高效执行该布局，历史仅处理一次并让梯度从各分支回传以实现端到端训练；并以树形key/value cache将历史共享扩展到受限解码。

Result: 在公开基准上，M&B优于强推荐基线，并显著提升训练与解码效率。

Conclusion: 通过压缩历史表示与多目标分支监督，并结合树形注意力与树形KV缓存，M&B在效果与效率上同时改善LLM生成式推荐，缓解了长历史编码成本与单目标监督之间的不对称问题。

Abstract: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. A tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. Abstract: Local-commerce and food-delivery marketplaces run large ads businesses: across hundreds of thousands of stores, merchants pay to be surfaced on browse and search surfaces, and a ranker decides which ads each consumer sees. Ranking well demands strong per-consumer personalization, yet a consumer's raw interaction history is sparse and high-cardinality. Our production ranker had personalized only through hand-engineered signals: aggregate engagement counts, categorical embeddings, and order-agnostic pooled history, with no learned per-consumer sequence representation. We learn one by training a GPT-style generative model of the consumer's engagement sequence to predict their next few engagements, and read its last-token hidden state as the consumer embedding. That single frozen vector becomes one shared personalization input for every ad surface: a daily job refreshes it, and each ranker consumes it as an ordinary dense feature. Offline it is the largest single-feature gain in our ranking-AUC ladder, a relative Eval-AUC gain of +0.59% on a browse-driven feed and +0.57% on a query-driven search surface. Online, it shipped as one component of bundled ranker retrains on both surfaces: Discovery (revenue +0.79%, conversion rate +1.17%) and Search (revenue +0.94%, conversion rate +1.50%). Three design choices adapt the generative objective to a repurchase-heavy marketplace, and are the core of our contribution: an exploration-weighted loss that up-weights businesses new to the consumer over ones already engaged; a two-stage curriculum: a click pretrain that keeps the representation broad and exploratory, then a conversion fine-tune that sharpens purchase intent; and a designed negative set that pairs a fixed popular-business pool and businesses shown but not ordered with random and in-batch negatives.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. Therefore, personalized item representations in user history provide a new scaling dimension for improving recommendation quality.

</details>

*Renzhi Wu,Li Sheng,Zikun Cui,Junjie Yang,Tai Guo,Keke Zhai,Yan Li,Jerry Fu,Nipun Mathur,Sri Reddy,Hong Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR)，将类型化证据存入持久化证据库、仅传播固定尺寸的候选相关工作区，使历史长度与推理深度可独立扩展，在长序列推荐中同时优于现有序列编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列推荐存在两条扩展轴：证据扩展（更长的历史）与推理扩展（更多层来解读证据）。现有模型将二者耦合——序列编码器把每个新增事件逐层传播，而一次性选择又使后续层无法重新访问被省略的证据，导致历史长度与深度的增长互相牵制、代价高且不灵活。

Conclusion: 将可寻址证据与传播状态解耦，使"读更多"与"想更深"可独立调控且联合有效，为长序列推荐提供了可分解扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Long-sequence recommendation can improve along two axes: \emph{evidence scaling} exposes longer histories, while \emph{reasoning scaling} adds layers that interpret that evidence for a candidate. Each layer rereads the banks from its evolving workspace and archives compact post-interaction state, allowing history length and reasoning depth to grow independently. LWR leads all families at long histories, continues improving with reasoning compute, and converts additional training compute into quality gains at the fastest fitted rate on the joint frontier. At 10K history, it improves NE by 0.19% over HSTU while using 69.6% fewer forward GFLOP/request. It also outperforms existing baselines on two billion-scale ranking surfaces. These results show that separating addressable evidence from propagated state makes reading more and reasoning deeper independently controllable and jointly useful.

</details>


### [49] [A Sequential Decision Framework for Evaluating LLM-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39231)
*Siqing Huo,Andrew Parry,Debasis Ganguly,Mark Smucker,Charles L. A. Clarke*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一个用于统一刻画 RAG 与"深度研究"式迭代检索策略的抽象框架，将检索环境建模为带排序列表集合，以 select/spawn 两种原语动作描述搜索行为，并给出奖励与强化学习解释，在 HRIR 任务上验证了检索方法与搜索策略均显著影响性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 与深度研究系统自主地迭代生成查询、检索文档并据此决定下一步搜索，但系统必须显式决定探索哪些搜索轨迹、优化什么目标；目前缺乏对这种搜索策略进行原则性评价的统一框架。

Method: 将搜索环境抽象为一组排序列表（ranked lists）；用两种原语动作描述行为：select（在已有排序中推进判断）与 spawn（通过查询生成或改写产生新排序）；每个动作产出待检视文档、更新搜索状态并贡献任务相关奖励；通过奖励与权重函数刻画常见检索目标于搜索轨迹之上，并可自然转化为强化学习形式；以高召回信息检索（HRIR）为实例进行说明与实验。

Result: 在该抽象下，多种现有检索策略均可表达为同一环境上的策略；实验表明底层检索方法与所采用的"深度研究"策略都会实质性地影响性能。

Conclusion: 该框架为经典检索任务与新兴 LLM 引导搜索系统提供了统一描述与推理方式，并给出原则化的评价路径；检索方法与搜索策略二者都需被纳入评估考量。

Abstract: Recent systems applying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and "deep research" iteratively generate queries, retrieve documents, and examine their contents, using the resulting information to guide subsequent search steps. When this process is carried out autonomously rather than by a human searcher, the system must make explicit decisions about which search trajectories to explore and what objective the search is intended to optimize. We introduce a simple framework for reasoning about such search policies, providing a principled approach to evaluation. The framework models the search environment as a set of ranked lists and represents behavior using two primitive actions: select, which advances judgment through an existing ranking, and spawn, which generates a new ranking through query generation or reformulation. Each action produces a document to inspect, yields information that updates the search state, and contributes a reward for a task-specific objective. Within this abstraction, a variety of existing retrieval strategies can be expressed as policies operating over a common environment, while common retrieval objectives can be represented through reward and weighting functions over the resulting search trajectory, and the resulting formulation admits a natural reinforcement learning interpretation. We illustrate the approach using high-recall information retrieval (HRIR), where the goal is to identify as many relevant documents as possible with limited judging effort, showing how the framework provides a unified way to describe and reason about strategies for both classical retrieval tasks and emerging LLM-guided search systems. Through experiments, we demonstrate that both the underlying retrieval method and the "deep research" policy employed can materially affect performance.

</details>


### [50] [CASH: A Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for Advertiser Subsidy Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39244)
*Minmao Wang,Huihuang Lin,Likang Wu,Hongke Zhao,Shijie Yi,Fei Pan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出CASH（Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness），将知识引导的LLM与数据驱动的数值响应模型结合，通过显式"能力许可证"机制在账户与补贴档位层面控制来源选择、智能体审核与预算分配，并用期望策略覆盖增益（EPCG）指导有限反馈预算的投放。在广告平台为期一个月、覆盖60%流量的在线实验中，CASH在补贴率基本不变的情况下使单账户收入提升15.35%、ADVV提升19.86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广告平台通过计费折扣向广告主提供补贴，Advertiser Subsidy Allocation（ASA）需在全平台补贴率约束下为每个账户选择补贴档位以最大化折扣收益。实践中补贴配置依赖业务规则、广告主分层与经营目标，虽蕴含丰富经验，但随着广告主规模扩大，分层级策略既无法刻画单个账户在不同补贴档位下的差异化响应，也无法以单账户粒度分配共享预算。

Method: CASH将知识引导的LLM与数据驱动的数值响应模型配对，从实际投放结果中学习二者在各账户和各补贴档位上的局部可靠性，并将该可靠性转化为显式的"能力许可证"，用以约束来源选择、智能体审核与预算分配；以Expected Policy Coverage Gain（EPCG）将有限反馈预算导向预期能扩展高价值可靠覆盖的证据，反馈结果进一步改进数值模型并更新能力估计。

Result: 在一个月、覆盖某大型广告平台60%流量的在线实验中，相较对照组，CASH在补贴率基本不变的前提下将单账户收入提升15.35%、ADVV提升19.86%，并在收入质量、LTV与留存方面取得进一步提升。

Conclusion: 将LLM的业务知识与数据驱动模型结合，并以可靠性驱动的能力许可证机制协调二者，可在细粒度账户层面实现更优的补贴分配；在线实验验证了该框架在收益、单位账户价值及长期指标上的实际有效性。

Abstract: Advertising platforms subsidize advertisers through billing discounts, and Advertiser Subsidy Allocation (ASA) chooses a subsidy level for every account to maximize total discounted revenue under a platform-wide subsidy-rate constraint. In practice, operators configure these subsidies from business rules, advertiser tiers and operating goals. Such configuration draws on rich business experience, yet as the advertiser base grows, tier-level policies can neither resolve how individual accounts respond across subsidy levels nor allocate a shared budget at the granularity of single accounts. We propose CASH, a Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for ASA. CASH pairs a knowledge-guided large language model (LLM) with a data-driven numerical response model, learns from realized outcomes where each is locally reliable across accounts and subsidy levels, and turns this reliability into explicit capability licenses that govern source selection, agent review and budget allocation. Its Expected Policy Coverage Gain (EPCG) directs a limited feedback budget toward evidence expected to expand high-value reliable coverage, and the resulting feedback further improves the numerical model and updates capability estimates. In a one-month online experiment with CASH serving 60% of a large-scale advertising platform's traffic, CASH raises revenue per account by 15.35% and ADVV by 19.86% over Control at an essentially unchanged subsidy rate, with further gains in revenue quality, LTV and retention.

</details>


### [51] [PFA: Attention Can Be Progressively Focused in Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39273)
*Pengjie Zhou,Weiqin Yang,Haibo Xing,Hao Deng,Jinxin Hu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文观察到生成式推荐解码中注意力呈现"渐进聚焦"与"跨步排序一致"两性质，提出渐进聚焦注意力（PFA）稀疏解码框架：首步全注意力、跨束加权聚合共享重要性排序并重排KV缓存为连续布局，后续步骤复用排序并几何缩减token预算，在公开与工业数据上优于SOTA且线上A/B取得业务收益并保持低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长用户行为序列能提升生成式推荐（GR）效果，但自回归beam search解码时对长历史做全注意力导致在线推理延迟高。现有加速方案中，静态历史压缩易丢失关键语义，动态top-k稀疏注意力则因重复token选择与非连续内存访问带来显著开销，因此需要一个兼顾语义保真与低开销的长序列解码方案。

Method: 先分析GR解码的注意力模式，归纳出渐进聚焦与跨步排序一致性两点性质；据此设计PFA：初始解码步保留全注意力以探索全局历史偏好；通过跨beam加权聚合建立共享重要性排序，并将选中token的KV缓存重排为连续内存布局；后续解码步复用该排序并几何式缩减token预算，辅以连续内存访问降低计算与访存开销。

Result: 在两个公开基准和一个大规模工业数据集上，PFA优于现有SOTA基线；在大型电商广告平台进行7天在线A/B测试，PFA带来显著业务收益，同时保持较低推理延迟。

Conclusion: PFA通过利用解码注意力的渐进聚焦与排序稳定性，实现稀疏化的长序列生成式推荐高效解码，在效果、延迟与线上业务指标上均取得收益，代码已开源。

Abstract: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence GR. PFA retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. It then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. Subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget, preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that PFA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. A 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that PFA delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PFA-review-088D.

</details>


### [52] [Federated Recommender Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39289)
*Jaehyung Lim,Woojoo Kim,Junyoung Kim,Dongha Kim,Wonbin Kweon,Hwanjo Yu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出联邦推荐智能体设定与FedRecAgent框架，在不上传交互历史与个性化记忆、不更新LLM参数的前提下，通过自然语言形式的C-T-R推理单元实现本地智能体间的知识协作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的推荐智能体依赖推理与记忆实现个性化，但集中式获取用户信息带来隐私问题；完全孤立的智能体又无法借鉴他人经验。因此需要在保护本地交互历史与个人记忆的前提下实现跨用户协作。

Method: 将本地经验表示为条件-转移-推理（C-T-R）单元，按条件与转移进行分层整合：在同一结构下合并相关解释，并区分不同转移路径上的推理。每个客户端维护语义记忆与决策记忆，分别刻画偏好与特定条件下的选择倾向，用于指导共享推理的检索与筛选；整个过程不更新LLM参数。

Result: 在三个领域的稠密与稀疏设定下，推荐性能优于联邦学习类与LLM类基线；消融实验验证了个性化记忆与结构化推理整合的贡献。

Conclusion: 以自然语言推理为共享载体、以本地记忆为个性化锚点的联邦智能体协作，可在不泄露交互数据、不微调模型的情况下有效提升推荐效果。

Abstract: LLM-powered recommender agents use reasoning and memory for personalization, but centralized access to user information raises privacy concerns, while isolated agents cannot learn from others' experiences. We formulate Federated Recommender Agents, a setting where local agents collaborate through natural-language knowledge while keeping interaction histories and personal memories local. We propose FedRecAgent, which enables this collaboration without updating LLM parameters. Its central challenge is determining which reasoning to integrate, since similar behavioral contexts can lead to different choices. FedRecAgent represents local experiences as Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) units and hierarchically integrates reasoning by condition and transition. Within this structure, it consolidates related explanations and discriminates reasoning across alternative transitions. Each client maintains semantic and decision memories to capture preferences and conditional choice tendencies, guiding the retrieval and selection of shared reasoning for recommendation. Experiments across three domains under dense and sparse settings demonstrate improved recommendation performance over federated and LLM-based baselines, while ablations support the contributions of personalized memories and structured reasoning integration.

</details>

*Sam Agnoli,Brigid Reilly,Lily Barna,Emőke-Ágnes Horvát*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了Google AI Overviews（AIOs）在健康信息场景下的信源选择、内容溯源（grounding）与准确性，发现AIOs信源质量和溯源支持度均较差，与医师评分标准相比得分偏低，且准确性与其引用溯源无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIOs作为搜索首位结果，将信源选择与评估的工作从用户转移给Gemini；在健康领域，Google传统算法本应优先高质量信源，而失实信息存在健康风险，因此需检验AIOs是否维持乃至改进信息质量。

Method: 基于3,611个基准健康问题，将每个AIO与该问题传统搜索前五结果在信源选择与质量上比较（六项信源可信度标准）；评估AIO陈述对其引用页面的溯源支持度（并校正分类器误差）；再以医师撰写的评分量表（rubric）评定准确性、完整性等。

Result: 96.4%的问题出现Overview；仅44.4%的传统前五结果被AIO引用，AIO过度偏重商业健康出版商（WebMD、Healthline），压缩学术与政府信源（Cleveland Clinic、NHS）；AIO引用页面在六项可信度标准中的四项得分低于传统结果；校正后约56.7%的被引陈述获得其引用页面支持，另有20.8%的陈述为无引用的断言；按医师量表仅获得38.2%的可用分数（准确性54.2%、完整性21.6%）；在医师预设存在具体错误或潜在有害主张的子集中，22.2%的AIO确实包含有害内容；AIO准确性与溯源支持度无关联。

Conclusion: AIOs在健康信息上的信源质量与溯源支持不足，且准确性独立于引用溯源，说明"有引用"不等于"可信"。建议开展面向用户的AIO素养干预，并要求AIO至少遵守Google自身的健康信息排序标准。

Abstract: Google's AI Overviews (AIOs) are the first result users encounter when searching the web, shifting the work of selecting and evaluating sources from the user to Gemini. This may be especially consequential for health information, given that Google's traditional algorithm was designed to prioritize quality sources, and inaccurate information carries health risks. We evaluated 3,611 benchmark health questions, comparing each AIO against that question's top five traditional results on source selection and quality. We also evaluated the AIOs' statement grounding in their cited sources and how accurate AIOs were against physician-written rubrics. Overviews appeared for 96.4% of questions but drew on substantially different evidence than traditional search: only 44.4% of the top five results were cited by the corresponding AIO, which instead overrepresented commercial health publishers (e.g., WebMD, Healthline) at the expense of academic and government sources (e.g., Cleveland Clinic, National Health Service). AIO-cited pages scored lower than traditional results on four of six well-established credibility criteria. The grounding of AIO statements to their sources was poor: after correcting for classifier error, an estimated 56.7% of cited statements were supported by their cited page, and a further 20.8% of all statements were factual claims with no citation at all. When AIOs were graded against physicians' rubrics, they earned 38.2% of all available points (e.g., accuracy 54.2%, completeness 21.6%), and among the subset of AIOs whose physician rubric anticipated a specific inaccurate or potentially harmful claim, 22.2% of AIOs contained the harmful content. Notably, the accuracy of AIOs was unrelated to the grounding of their statements. We recommend AIO literacy interventions for users and holding AIOs at least to Google's own health-ranking standards.

</details>


### [54] [Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39352)
*Xu Huang,Jiawei Feng,Jiancan Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RecRSI提出用“诊断→多样候选编辑→短试跑+全排序NDCG@10探针选择”取代逐条试错的推荐模型训练配方自改进，显著减少无效全量重训。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web平台推荐系统需为每个数据集重新调参，LLM agent可改写训练配方实现递归自改进（RSI）。但现有agent每轮只提一个编辑、必须全量重训、仅以排序质量提升决定保留，导致两个问题：(1) 排序反馈延迟，编辑效果只有重训后才能得知，大量重训预算浪费在被丢弃的编辑上；(2) 重训前的信号不可靠——采样训练损失可能显示“已解决”而全排序性能仍差，且改变损失或采样器后跨编辑不可比。

Method: RecRSI基于当前模型的诊断生成多样的候选配方编辑；对每个候选只做短试跑（即其全量训练的前若干步），用留出探针用户上的full-ranking NDCG@10打分，据此选出唯一一个进行全量重训，实现以早期排序反馈做候选筛选。

Result: 在两个序列推荐模型、三个数据集上，在相同全量重训次数下，RecRSI在所有设置中显著优于现有自进化agent；在两个Amazon数据集上，其第一轮即达到的排序质量是现有方法五轮内均未达到的。

Conclusion: 以full-ranking探针指标作为早期排序反馈进行候选选择，可有效缓解排序反馈延迟与中间信号不可靠的问题，提升推荐系统训练配方递归自改进的预算效率与最终排序质量。

Abstract: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.

</details>


### [55] [UGR: Unified Generative Ranking for Heterogeneous E-commerce Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39426)
*Zonghe Shao,Huabin Chen,Sitong Lu,Fangmei Zhu,Yingcai Ma,Ge Fan,Jinguo Gao,Wei Shi,Yanfang Liu,Huiping Chu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出统一生成排序框架UGR，在请求级多业务异构候选集（约千个）上进行候选感知自回归解码，直接生成多业务排序列表，突破曝光序列模仿并联合建模广告价值与GSP机制，在淘宝"猜你喜欢"上线取得显著业务收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商列表排序需在自然内容、广告及其他业务候选中平衡用户效用与商业价值，并建模候选间交互与序列依赖。现有生成式排序方法存在两点不足：(1) 仅从曝光序列学习，未充分利用曝光后的反馈信号；(2) 多在单一业务的截断候选集上生成，对异构多业务候选且需在GSP拍卖下联合建模排序分数与广告价值的问题探索不足。

Method: 1) 对全请求级多业务异构候选集（生产中约千个候选）做生成式排序，通过候选感知的自回归解码直接产出多业务排序列表；2) 在曝光序列模仿之外引入互补反馈监督：加权监督微调（利用观测到的曝光后反馈）与排列偏好优化（利用由反馈导出的排列间偏好）；3) 训练期广告去偏塔建模历史广告曝光效应，服务期融入当前广告价值，同时保持既有分配与GSP定价规则不变；4) 由多值序列检索产出候选排序列表，交下游已有评估器选出最终曝光列表。

Result: 离线实验显示排序质量稳定提升；淘宝"猜你喜欢"在线A/B测试相对生产基线：Core IPV提升1.76%，交易量提升3.29%，GMV提升2.10%。

Conclusion: UGR证明生成式排序可有效扩展到多业务异构全量候选场景，结合反馈监督与广告去偏、并在不改变GSP机制的前提下融合广告价值，能同时在用户效用与商业价值上取得实际收益，具备工业落地价值。

Abstract: List-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content, ads, and candidates from other businesses, while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. Existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. Exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. Meanwhile, generative ranking over heterogeneous, multi-business candidates remains less explored, particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price (GSP) auctions. We propose Unified Generative Ranking (UGR), which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set, typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production, and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decoding. To go beyond exposure-sequence imitation, UGR introduces complementary feedback supervision through weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization, which respectively leverage observed post-exposure feedback and feedback-derived preferences among permutations. UGR uses a training-time advertising debiasing tower to model historical ad exposure effects and incorporates current ad value during serving while preserving the existing allocation and GSP pricing rules. Multi-value sequence retrieval produces candidate ranking lists, and the existing downstream evaluator selects the final list for exposure. Offline experiments demonstrate consistent gains in ranking quality, while online A/B tests on Taobao's Guess You Like recommendation service yield improvements of 1.76% in Core IPV, 3.29% in Transaction Volume, and 2.10% in GMV over the production baseline.

</details>


### [56] [RoFiGR: Coarse Routing, Fine Refinement via Level-Adaptive Distillation in Multimodal Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39470)
*Ji Dai,Zhipeng Wei,Zhuang Zhuang,Rongfeng Guo,Jie Chen,Quan Fang,Fei Pan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RoFiGR双树生成式推荐器，在SID构建与生成两阶段引入协同信息以缓解粗粒度路由错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐逐码预测物品语义标识（SID），早期码决定粗粒度分支，路由错误会在细粒度预测前就排除相关物品；多模态推荐中粗粒度决策还需同时反映协同偏好与物品语义。

Method: 双树结构：将累积L1-L2码向量与冻结的协同物品嵌入对齐；在序列化历史中显式编码物品距离与来源层级；生成阶段用顺序教师监督合法分支，固定粗粒度权重维持路由监督，并以有界自适应残差按教师-学生需求分配附加权重。

Result: 在Instruments、Arts、Games三个数据集上，五项排序指标均优于所评估的外部基线；五种子配对检验（Holm校正）支持主要NDCG@10提升；与替代协同监督目标及tokenizer的对比支持该设计；匹配的任务与解码分析区分了训练曝光、流融合与候选预算的影响。

Conclusion: 在SID构建与生成中双重注入协同信号，可有效改善粗粒度路由质量并提升多模态生成式推荐的排序效果。

Abstract: Generative recommenders predict an item's semantic identifier (SID) one code at a time. Early codes select broad branches, so a routing error can exclude relevant items before fine-grained prediction begins. In multimodal recommendation, these coarse decisions must reflect collaborative preferences as well as item semantics. We introduce RoFiGR, a two-tree recommender that uses collaborative information in both SID construction and generation. It aligns cumulative L1-L2 code vectors with frozen collaborative item embeddings and explicitly encodes item distance and source level in the serialized history. During generation, a sequential teacher supervises legal branches. Fixed coarse-level weights maintain routing supervision, while a bounded adaptive residual allocates additional weight according to teacher-student demand. On Instruments, Arts, and Games, RoFiGR improves all five ranking metrics over the evaluated external baselines. Five-seed paired tests with Holm correction support the main NDCG@10 improvements. Comparisons with alternative collaborative supervision objectives and tokenizers support the proposed design. Matched task and decoding analyses distinguish the effects of training exposure, stream fusion, and candidate budgets.

</details>


### [57] [GistRank: Gist-Compressed Listwise Ranking with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39610)
*Guo Chen,Wenhan Liu,Reed Li,Qianwen Ma,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi,Bingbing Xu,Junjie Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 GistRank，用软压缩（gist）表示 passages 提升 LLM listwise 排序效率，每篇压缩为 4 个 gist token，相比全文本排序提速 14×，nDCG@10 平均 59.17，距最强全上下文基线仅 0.89。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM listwise 排序需逐字序列化所有候选并自回归生成排列，输入随候选数量与长度线性增长，推理代价高；滑窗排名需重复重编码重叠块，硬压缩又损失细粒度判别信息。作者因此系统研究软压缩的权衡，并发现朴素 gist 表示不适合排序：严格因果编码削弱 gist token 对 passage 的吸收，且该表示从未被训练以暴露区分相近候选的相对偏好结构。

Method: GistRank 采用三阶段训练框架：(1) 在半双向注意力机制下学习忠实的 gist token 表示；(2) 通过 pairwise 训练注入判别性比较能力；(3) 使模型适配 listwise 目标。每篇 passage 被压缩为 K=4 个 gist token。

Result: 相比一次性全文本排序获得 14× 加速；在 TREC DL19/20 与五个 BEIR 子集上平均 nDCG@10 达 59.17，与最强全上下文基线差距仅 0.89。

Conclusion: GistRank 为真实场景搜索提供了一种有效提升效率的手段，在保持接近全上下文排序精度的同时显著降低推理成本。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking, which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. However, processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly, every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. While sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks, hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. To better understand and mitigate this trade-off, we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for LLM-based listwise ranking. Our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons: strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage, and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. To this end, we propose GistRank, a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme, instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training, and adapting the model to the listwise objective. GistRank collapses each passage into only $K{=}4$ gist tokens, this gives 14$\times$ speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average nDCG@10 over TREC DL19/20 and five BEIR subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. Overall, GistRank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

</details>


### [58] [Efficient LLM-based Subgraph Retrieval for Multi-Hop Knowledge Base Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39667)
*Duanyang Yuan,Sihang Zhou,Xiaoshu Chen,Haoyuan Chen,Ke Liang,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM与蒙特卡洛树搜索的子图检索方法M-ER，通过节点优先选择与量化打分过滤无关节点，在WebQSP上Hits@1达78.88%并提升计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IR式多跳KBQA从全库抽取的关键子图常含弱相关或无关节点；缺乏节点过滤机制时，无关节点随跳数增加而膨胀，导致计算资源过度消耗。

Method: 将子图探索转化为树结构搜索：用MCTS的选择阶段优先纳入与问题高度相关的节点，避免遍历全库节点；引入LLM修正搜索方向；对选中节点定量打分并回馈至节点选择环节，过滤无关候选。

Result: 在WebQSP基准上Hits@1为78.88%，同时提升计算效率。

Conclusion: M-ER验证了有效性，并提供兼顾性能与计算效率的可行技术路径。

Abstract: Multi-hop Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) aims to find answer entities in the knowledge base that are multiple hops away from the entities in the question. Information retrieval-based (IR-based) methods extract a pivotal subgraph from the entire KB to locate candidate answers and then evaluate their plausibility through semantic matching with the question. However, we observed that the extracted subgraphs often include nodes that are weakly related or irrelevant to the question. Without a proper node filtering mechanism, the number of irrelevant nodes grows as the number of hops increases, leading to excessive consumption of computational resources. To address these challenges, this study introduces an efficient LLM-based subgraph retrieval method for multi-hop knowledge base question answering, M-ER. The framework leverages Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to transform subgraph exploration into a tree-structured search process. During the MCTS selection phase, nodes that are highly relevant to the question are prioritized for inclusion in the subgraph, eliminating the need to traverse all nodes in the KB. The framework further incorporates a large language model (LLM) to refine the search direction, ensuring that exploration remains focused on nodes relevant to the question. In addition, selected nodes are quantitatively scored, and these scores are fed back into the node selection process to effectively filter out irrelevant candidates, thereby improving the quality of the subgraph. This mechanism not only narrows the search space but also enhances the overall efficiency of multi-hop KBQA. Experiments on the WebQSP benchmark demonstrate that M-ER achieves 78.88\% on the Hits@1 metric, while also improving computational efficiency. These results not only validate the effectiveness of M-ER, but also offer a viable technical path to balance performance and computational efficiency.

</details>


### [59] [R2QRec: Learning Recommendation Queries from Retrieval Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39984)
*Weixin Chen,Shuchang Liu,Hailan Yang,Yuhan Zhao,Li Kang,Xuefeng Zhang,Chenghao Zhang,Xinyuan Wang,Hanchen Yang,Yinghao Wu,Hua Huang,Yandong Bai,Fan Yang,Xiang Li,Chunjie Chen,Li Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: R2QRec 用固定检索系统构造查询监督并评估推荐结果，分两阶段训练查询生成器：检索验证筛选能召回已交互物品的生成表达作为SFT目标，策略精化用融合推荐列表中的对数排名反馈做强化学习并加KL约束，在三个公开数据集上取得最优整体推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于查询的推荐把“表达用户需求”与“定位匹配物品”解耦，但其核心学习难题在于交互日志不含查询标注，如何将物品交互转化为有效检索请求缺乏监督信号。

Method: 两阶段框架，仅训练查询生成器，检索器与物品索引固定：(1) 检索验证——选取能召回已观测物品的生成表达式作为监督微调目标，由检索行为决定目标措辞；(2) 策略精化——按已观测物品在新生成查询集融合推荐列表中的排名评估查询集，利用对数排名（log-rank）反馈区分推荐截断之外的结果，并用KL惩罚约束策略相对监督参考的偏移。无需查询标注或学习型奖励模型。

Result: 在三个公开数据集上，R2QRec 在所评估方法中取得最优的整体推荐性能；大量实验验证了设计有效性，以及在生成器与领域上的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 以固定检索系统同时充当监督构造器与结果评估器，可将无标注交互日志转化为查询生成的可学习信号；检索验证负责“学什么表达”，策略精化负责“优化融合排序”，二者分工明确，构成无需查询标注的查询式推荐训练范式。

Abstract: Query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. Its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. We present R2QRec, which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. Retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets, allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. Policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. Log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff, while a KL penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. The stages have distinct roles: verification identifies expressions to imitate, and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. Only the query generator is trained; the retriever and item index remain fixed, and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. Across three public datasets, R2QRec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.

</details>


### [60] [Beyond IPS: Reliable Counterfactual Evaluation in Multi-Stage Ad Systems without Logged Propensities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40112)
*Mohsen Malmir,Mohamed A. Radwan,Houssam Nassif,Murat Ali Bayir*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出混合加权奖励建模（mixture-weighted reward modeling），用多分类域分类器估计密度比对日志数据重加权至候选策略分布的混合，从而在无倾向性时稳健地进行离线广告排序策略评估，并给出误差界与冷启动驱动的离线/线上路由规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段广告投放系统中动作倾向性（propensity）常不可得，IPS无法使用；DM类奖励模型虽无需倾向性，但当候选策略诱导的曝光分布与日志数据分布不一致时存在偏差，因此需要一种在分布偏移下更稳健的离线评估方法。

Method: 形式化基于DM的反事实回放；用多分类域分类器输出的密度比，将日志数据重加权至候选策略分布的混合，构建混合加权奖励模型；给出每个候选策略价值估计误差的上界（重叠项、冷启动项、回放项）；推导利用冷启动质量决定信任离线选择还是转线上A/B测试的渐近规则；并结合双稳健（DR）校正。

Result: 在广告投放模拟器和大规模CTR排序系统的生产流量上，混合加权奖励模型相较未加权版本均提升策略选择效果，模拟中低重叠情形增益最大；与DR校正结合后在生产的Top-1准确率最高，并在模拟的低、中重叠区间取得最高Top-1准确率。

Conclusion: 密度比混合加权可有效缓解DM在分布偏移下的偏差，配合理论误差界与冷启动路由规则形成可落地的离线评估框架，DR版本在离线策略选择中表现最佳。

Abstract: Offline evaluation of ad-ranking policies in multi-stage delivery systems is challenging because action propensities are often unavailable, limiting inverse propensity scoring (IPS). Reward-model-based estimators such as the Direct Method (DM) avoid propensities but can be biased when candidate policies induce impression distributions that differ from the logged data. We formalize DM-based counterfactual replay and propose mixture-weighted reward modeling, which reweights logged data toward a mixture of candidate-policy distributions using density ratios from a multiclass domain classifier. We bound each candidate's value-estimation error by overlap, cold-start, and replay terms, and derive an asymptotic rule that uses the cold-start mass to decide whether to trust offline selection or route candidates to online A/B testing. On an ads-delivery simulator and on production traffic from a large-scale CTR ranking system, the mixture-weighted reward model improves policy selection over its unweighted counterpart in both settings, with the largest gains at low overlap in simulation. Combined with a doubly robust correction, it attains the highest Top-1 accuracy in production and at low and medium overlap in simulation.

</details>


### [61] [xPRT: Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40122)
*Danush Khanna,Himanshu Singhal,Pranjal A. Chitale,Bishal Santra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: xPRT：一种跨段落检索预训练（Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining）无监督框架，利用单篇文档内跨段落的关键信息及其相互关系进行检索预训练，在MTEB English v2上平均超越最强基线3.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密检索器是RAG与搜索系统的核心组件，但其训练依赖昂贵的标注query-document对，仅少数资源充足领域可得。现有无监督检索预训练方法多在文档内短片段上优化语言建模或对比学习目标，学习信号有限。作者由此提出：如何从单篇文档中提取更丰富的检索学习信号？

Method: 提出xPRT框架，从分布于整篇文档的关键信息及其各部分之间的连接中学习，而非局限于短片段。实验在MTEB English v2上，与五种最先进目标函数对比；从公开无监督检查点继续预训练，并固定语料、调度与训练流程，以保证公平比较。另通过受控消融验证跨段落信号的作用。

Result: 在覆盖全部任务类型的多样任务上，xPRT平均比最强基线高3.2%。在持续预训练设定下，许多基线方法出现明显性能回退，而xPRT相对初始预训练检查点取得最大的互补增益。消融实验确认性能提升源于所提出的跨段落信号。

Conclusion: 单篇无标注文档所含检索信号远比此前假设的丰富，xPRT能提供与现有检索器已捕获信息互补的增益。

Abstract: Dense retrievers are a foundational component underlying modern RAG and search systems. Training these models typically requires a curated collection of annotated query-document pairs, which are prohibitively expensive to obtain outside a handful of well-resourced domains. This has motivated a line of work that leverages large-scale unsupervised retrieval pretraining from unlabelled text alone. Most such methods learn by optimizing a language modelling or contrastive learning objective over short spans within a document. This raises the question: how can we extract richer learning signals from a single document for retrieval pretraining? To address it, we introduce xPRT (Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining), an unsupervised framework that learns from the key information distributed across an entire document and the connections between its parts. We evaluate xPRT against five state-of-the-art objectives on MTEB English v2, continuing pretraining from a public unsupervised checkpoint while holding the corpus, schedule, and training procedure fixed. Across diverse tasks spanning all task types, we observe that xPRT consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.2% on an average. Notably, in this continual pretraining setting, many baseline methods incur substantial performance regressions, whereas our method delivers the largest complementary gains over the initial pretrained checkpoint. Controlled ablations confirm that xPRT's performance gains stem from its proposed cross-passage signals. xPRT demonstrates that a single unlabelled document is a much richer source of retrieval signal than prior work assumed and offers complementary gains to what current retrievers already capture.

</details>


### [62] [Decompose, Estimate, Select: Coverage-Aware Context Construction for Long-Form RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40314)
*He Tu,Aleena Bosco Kurumthottam,Torsten Suel*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出覆盖面感知检索流程（子问题分解+覆盖训练双编码器+交叉编码器覆盖矩阵+贪心最大边际覆盖选择），并结合grounded self-feedback loop提升答案完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG中基于相关性的检索对多层面复杂问题会返回冗余证据，同时遗漏部分层面，导致证据覆盖不足。

Method: 1) 将查询分解为子问题；2) 用覆盖训练的双编码器排序候选；3) 用交叉编码器预测文档×子问题覆盖矩阵；4) 按贪心最大边际覆盖选择文档；5) 引入grounded self-feedback loop，让模型从首轮答案中识别未充分利用的证据并再次生成（无金标监督）。

Result: TREC RAG 2024上α-nDCG@10从0.625提升至0.702，接近金标nugget上界0.718且不损相关性；oracle检索虽覆盖更高，但答案nugget覆盖未优于估计选择；self-feedback两轮将V_strict提升0.086并基本保持忠实性。

Conclusion: 答案完整性既取决于检索到什么证据，也取决于生成器如何有效利用证据；覆盖感知检索与生成端自我反馈共同提升完整性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's output in retrieved evidence, but for complex questions spanning multiple aspects of an information need, relevance-based retrieval may return redundant evidence while leaving some aspects unsupported. We propose a coverage-aware retrieval pipeline that decomposes queries into subquestions, ranks candidates with a coverage-trained bi-encoder, predicts a document\,$\times$\,subquestion coverage matrix with a cross-encoder, and selects documents by greedy maximum-marginal coverage. On TREC RAG 2024, our approach improves $α$-nDCG@10, which rewards newly covered nuggets and discounts redundant evidence, from $0.625$ to $0.702$, approaching the $0.718$ gold-nugget upper bound without sacrificing relevance. We then find that ground-truth oracle retrieval, despite substantially higher retrieval coverage, delivers no more nugget coverage to the answer than our estimated selection. This suggests that answer completeness depends not only on what evidence is retrieved, but also on how effectively the generator uses it. To address this, we introduce a \emph{grounded self-feedback loop} in which the model identifies underused evidence from its first answer and generates again without gold supervision, raising $V_{\mathrm{strict}}$, the fraction of vital reference nuggets fully supported by the answer, by $0.086$ over two passes while largely preserving faithfulness.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [63] [Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37712)
*Alicem Koyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MGO-SC：利用符号 EMA 幅值构造逐坐标“符号一致性门控”，并引入保均值变体以保持张量步长幅度，在标签噪声下优于 AdamW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应优化器在高随机性与标签噪声下梯度符号和幅值不稳定，导致行为退化；朴素门控只能缩小更新、损失有效步长。

Method: 基于符号指数移动平均（sign EMA）幅值构建逐坐标一致性门控：符号稳定的坐标被信任，符号波动的坐标降权；并设计保均值（mean-preserving）变体，在坐标间重分配信任而不改变张量整体步长。无二阶信息、无逐样本过滤。

Result: CIFAR-10 + ResNet-18，匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减下，在干净、对称与非对称标签噪声中稳定优于 AdamW（如 40% 对称噪声 +1.4 个点；配对 bootstrap 95% CI 不含零；Wilcoxon p<0.01）。报告匹配种子效应量、非参数 bootstrap 置信区间与配对显著性检验，并公开代码与原始日志。

Conclusion: 朴素符号一致性门控因只收缩更新而无益；保均值重分配是使该方法有效的关键，且以极低开销提升噪声鲁棒性。

Abstract: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.

</details>


### [64] [A Hybrid Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38269)
*Zhijie Su,Qiaolin He,Zhiping Mao,Shiquan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出混合物理信息全纯神经网络（HPIHNN），通过将解分解为特解（谱方法）与齐次解（仅用边界数据训练的PIHNN），解决非齐次PDE在复杂区域上的求解问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PIHNN借助复解析表示可“按构造”满足齐次PDE，但难以推广到非齐次问题；同时需避免复杂几何的网格划分并保留全纯表示的降维优势。

Method: 解分解为特解+齐次解：特解在简单扩展域上用谱方法计算；齐次解用PIHNN仅在边界上（使用修正边界数据）训练。整体避免复杂几何网格化，保留降维优势。

Result: 在非齐次Poisson、Stokes、双调和、线弹性与Helmholtz方程上测试；涵盖复杂几何、角点奇异性、近不可压情形，均能准确求解，且相比标准PINN通常误差更低、训练时间更短。

Conclusion: 谱特解与全纯神经逼近的耦合为非齐次PDE在复杂区域上提供了一种高效求解途径。

Abstract: Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks (PIHNNs) exploit complex-analytic representations to satisfy homogeneous PDEs by construction, but their extension to nonhomogeneous problems is nontrivial. We propose a hybrid physics-informed holomorphic neural network (HPIHNN) framework based on a decomposition of the solution into particular and homogeneous components. The particular component is computed by a spectral method on a simple extended domain, while the homogeneous component is approximated by a PIHNN trained only on the boundary with modified boundary data. The resulting formulation avoids meshing complex geometries and retains the dimensionality-reduction advantage of holomorphic representations. The method is applied to nonhomogeneous Poisson, Stokes, biharmonic, linear elasticity, and Helmholtz equations. Numerical experiments covering complex geometries, corner singularities, and nearly incompressible regimes demonstrate that the proposed method accurately resolves the corresponding solutions and, in the considered tests, generally achieves lower errors and shorter training times than standard PINNs. The results indicate that coupling spectral particular solutions with holomorphic neural approximations provides an efficient approach to nonhomogeneous PDEs on complex domains.

</details>


### [65] [What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37719)
*Shikhar Shiromani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"杠杆"（leverage）度量——以更新方向的Fisher二次型除以同尺寸随机方向的Fisher二次型，可精确量化权重改变带来的行为效应，并据此排序预训练/SFT/RL/DPO各阶段达四个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练仅将权重按约千分之一范数移动却剧烈改变模型行为，而预训练移动约三分之一范数只带来缓慢漂移；缺乏一个能精确衡量"单位权重改变买到了什么"的指标。

Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

### [68] [Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39897)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Koopman框架通过线性算子表示动力系统，但数值近似Koopman（生成元）算子时，如何选取有效的有限维函数空间表示（即"字典"）是实际难点；现有数据无关的字典选择方法效果有限。

Method: 针对连续时间情形，考虑Koopman生成元的数值近似；构建数据驱动的随机特征方法，生成简约且有效的函数表示，用于gEDMD等Galerkin近似；该表示由数据信息引导，优于数据无关方法。

Result: 实验表明该方法在预测任务与系统分析上准确，且快于迭代优化；理论上证明了向量场近似及所得轨迹的收敛性，给出gEDMD生成的半群的一般收敛判据，并构造反例说明gEDMD一般不保持指数有界性。

Conclusion: 该工作推进了从数据中高效学习连续时间动力学的研究，朝基于Koopman框架的可解释、数学稳健建模方向发展。

Abstract: Learning continuous-time dynamical systems from data is an active area of research. The Koopman formalism is often used here, because it is a flexible approach that is informative about the system's fundamental properties. The formalism represents dynamical systems through linear operators acting on a suitable function space. A practical difficulty arising in the numerical approximation of Koopman operators is the choice of a ``dictionary'', meaning an effective finite-dimensional representation of the function space. In this paper, we focus on learning dynamical systems in continuous-time, and so we consider numerical approximations of the Koopman generator instead of the Koopman operator. Our main contribution is a data-driven random-feature method to obtain a parsimonious and effective function representation for Galerkin approximation methods such as gEDMD. The representation we construct is data-informed, which allows us to improve upon data-agnostic methods. We empirically demonstrate the suitability of our method for forecasting tasks and system analysis. The numerical experiments show that our approach is accurate, and faster than iterative optimization. Further, we prove convergence of our approximation of the vector field and the resulting trajectories. In addition to the numerical results, we also make theoretical contributions, including a general convergence criterion for the semigroup generated by the gEDMD approximation and a counterexample showing that gEDMD does not generally preserve exponential boundedness. With our contribution, we advance the frontier of efficiently learning continuous-time dynamics from data, towards interpretable and mathematically robust modelling based on the Koopman framework.

</details>

*Ioannis Konstantoulas,Iliana Loi,Kyriakos Sgarbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Native Predicate Neuron（谓词神经元），一种可微的一阶逻辑量化神经模块，可原生嵌入FC/CNN/RNN/Transformer，缓解不连续性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号推理方法依赖静态架构，难以融入深度神经网络与梯度优化；标准深度网络在处理不连续函数与单调推理时表现受限。

Method: 设计谓词神经元：用单一可训练参数学习在逻辑运算间切换以建模关系逻辑；采用双性质梯度机制——训练时执行硬逻辑运算同时保持可微以便反向传播；对输入与选择状态进行量化，从而逼近连续与非连续函数。已在Keras与PyTorch中实现。

Result: 在MNIST、Wikitext等基准上，于全连接、卷积、循环与Transformer架构中评测：引入谓词神经元总体加快收敛、提升精度、降低损失，在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 谓词神经元可原生集成到标准神经网络以实现模糊逻辑运算，为符号推理与深度学习的结合提供通用、可微且易部署的方案。

Abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

</details>

*Yaxuan Wu,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对荷兰多井地下水异常预测，提出上下文感知选择性学习（CASL），在冻结的无迁移与固定迁移父模型之间做校准训练的受限上下文混合，并对结果做严格结构诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源域预训练可提升平均精度，但在异质井上并非一致可靠：固定迁移在18.38–51.86%的井上造成性能退化，需要一种能按井选择性利用迁移的方法。

Method: CASL：以校准集训练的、受约束的上下文混合，融合冻结的"无迁移"与"固定迁移"父模型；对照为全局凸混合（每seed一个校准拟合权重）。任务设定为连续9个月观测输入、精确3个日历月目标、无插值；457口井、13,718个测试窗口、5个预定义seed，四单元maxsim0.60源池仅依据Always-TL验证RMSE冻结。
